title: A Bad Feeling
content:
Step 1: Pick Up the Quest

  • Pick up the quest called "A Bad Feeling" from Celeste at the central hub.
  • Your goal is to find and examine any ARC Probe or ARC Courier.

Step 2: Find an ARC Probe/Courier

ARC Probes and Couriers are not marked on your map at first; they only show up when you get nearby.

  • One confirmed spot for an ARC Probe is near the Hydroponic Dome Complex in the Dam Battlegrounds zone.
  • When you're near enough, the probe will show up on your map as a signal marker.

Step 3: Hack and grab the Probe

  • Walk over to the ARC Probe or Courier and use it to start the "Breach" process.
  • Hacking requires a brief moment, leaving you exposed meanwhile. Stay alert for threats behind you.
  • After hacking it, use it once more to "Search" the probe.
  • You usually get useful items such as ARC Alloy and ARC Performance Steel after searching.

Step 4: Finish the Quest

  • After you've examined the probe, the mission will register as finished.
  • Head back to Celeste at the hub to claim your rewards.
  • Your rewards are Metal Parts, Steel Spring, and Duct Tape.
summary: Learn how to find and investigate ARC Probes or Couriers to finish the "A Bad Feeling" quest in Arc Raiders, with a noted spot in the Dam Battlegrounds zone.
author: ARC Companion Team
objectives: Find and search any ARC Probe or ARC Courier

title: A Balanced Harvest
content:
This guide walks you through the "A Balanced Harvest" quest, explaining how to find Lucille Ludi's notes to finish the task. This mission has you navigating through the Research & Administration building and find specific research project notes.

Step 1: Navigate to the Research & Administration Building

Start by opening your map and locating the Research & Administration building. You can recognize it by its unique design and is near the Control Tower, as shown.

  • The structure sits in the Dam Battlegrounds zone.
  • Find the building marked "Research & Administration" on your map, situated near the "Control Tower" landmark.

Step 2: Go Within the Building

Walk up to the building and find an accessible entry point. The easiest path is usually through damaged sections or openings at ground level.

  • Go into the building via the open section or damaged wall on the ground floor.
  • This way in takes you to a lower-level area, likely a reception or maintenance section.

Step 3: Climb to the Upper Floor

After entering, your goal is to arrive at the upper floor above the reception area. Use the environment to climb upwards.

  • Find the accessible elevator shaft within the building.
  • Use the shaft to climb up to the next floor.
  • When you head over to the upper floor, you'll be in what appears to be a reception or office area.
  • Turn right from the elevator shaft and continue down the corridor.
  • You'll see Lab 1 written on the wall

Step 4: Find Lucille Ludi's Notes

Move through the upper floor, following the path through the laboratory sections until you find a desk with a computer where the notes are located.

  • Keep moving through the hallways, going right when needed to progress through the lab.
  • There is the notes on a desk beside an old terminal, lit by sunlight through the big windows.

Step 5: Pick Up the Notes

After you notice Lucille Ludi's notes on the desk, walk toward them and interact to collect them, finishing the mission task.

  • Use the notes to pick them up.
  • Grabbing the notes will trigger the mission completion for "A Balanced Harvest."
summary: A detailed walkthrough for finishing the "A Balanced Harvest" quest in Arc Raiders, centered on finding and gathering Lucille Ludi's notes within the Research & Administration building.

Go to the Research & Administration building

title: A Better Use
content:
To complete 'A Better Use' quest, you must interact with Supply Beacons found around the map and then grab the resource drops they provide.

Step 1: Find a Supply Beacon

  • Start by opening your map to see your current missions. The 'A Better Use' quest will guide you to areas containing Supply Beacons.
  • Identify the 'Supply Beacon' icon on your map. These are usually placed in certain areas for the quest.
  • As mentioned, there is these stations in several spots, like the Village, Supply Beacon, or Reinforced Reception areas.

Step 2: Request a resource drop

  • Go to one of the marked Supply Beacon locations on the map.
  • When you get there, find a antenna-shaped tower. This is the Supply Beacon.
  • Go toward the station and press and hold the action button (E on PC) to 'REQUEST resource drop'.
  • The station then triggers a request for a resource drop.

Step 3: grab the Drop

  • After requesting the resource drop, check the sky above. A drone will fly in and drop a supply crate.
  • Note that the resource drop might not land at the exact spot where you requested it; keep an eye on where it drops.
  • After the supply crate lands, continue to its location and use it to grab what's inside.
  • Picking up the resource drop finishes the 'A Better Use' quest.
summary: Follow along to complete the 'A Better Use' quest in Arc Raiders, which involves locating Supply Beacons, requesting resource drops, and then collecting the dropped items.

Loot a Supply Drop

title: A First Foothold
content:
This guide walks you through the 'A First Foothold' quest in Arc Raiders, showing you the exact locations and steps needed to use four different objectives on The Blue Gate map.

Step 1: Rotate the Satellite Dish

The first objective asks you to rotate a satellite dish located on the church roof, north of the Data Vault.

  • Check your map to find the church, which is north of the Data Vault.
  • Walk over to the church structure.
  • Climb the scaffolding on the side of the church to arrive at the roof.
  • After reaching the rooftop, find the satellite dish.
  • Use the satellite dish to rotate it and complete this objective.

Step 2: Nail Down the Roof Plates

For the second objective, you must nail down roof plates on a Raider structure near Trapper's Glade.

  • Travel to the indicated location on your map, near Trapper's Glade.
  • Find the Raider structure with the loose roof plates.
  • Head over to the roof plates and activate them to secure them.

Step 3: Enable the Comms Terminal

The third part of the quest involves enabling a comms terminal located near the Olive Grove.

  • Check your map for the exact location near the Olive Grove. This objective is slightly hidden.
  • Find the comms terminal on top of a broken truck or structure.
  • Use the comms terminal to enable it.

Step 4: Stabilize the Observation Deck

The final objective is to stabilize the observation deck near Ridgeline.

  • Head over to the Ridgeline area, as shown on your map.
  • Find the observation deck structure.
  • Activate the yellow marker to stabilize the deck and complete the 'A First Foothold' quest.
summary: A detailed guide to completing the 'A First Foothold' quest in Arc Raiders. This guide outlines the four distinct locations on The Blue Gate map where you must use various structures to progress and complete the mission objectives.

title: A Lay of the Land
content:
Overview

The 'A Lay of the Land' quest on Spaceport asks you to find shipping notes in the Jangsu Warehouse and then retrieve LIDAR scanners from Control Tower A6, followed by extraction.

Step 1: Find Jangsu Warehouse & Find Shipping Notes

  • Check your map and find the Jangsu Warehouse in the Spaceport area.
  • Walk to the back side of the warehouse where you'll discover an entrance.
  • Go through the door and continue up the stairs.
  • On the upper part of the stairs, turn right and enter the foreman's office.
  • On the desk, you'll discover the shipping notes. Interact to grab them.

Step 2: Head to Control Tower A6

  • After grabbing the notes, your objective will update to find the LIDAR scanners in Control Tower A6.
  • Pull up your map once more to find the location of Control Tower A6. It's to the southeast of the Jangsu Warehouse.
  • Head over to Control Tower A6.

Step 3: Retrieve LIDAR Scanners

  • Once inside Control Tower A6, continue to the upper floor. There are stairs leading up.
  • On the upper floor, around a corner, you'll discover the LIDAR scanners.
  • If your inventory is full, you may need to drop an item to pick up the scanners.

Step 4: Extract with LIDAR Scanners

  • After you get picked up the LIDAR scanners, your objective will update to deliver them to Stani, which has you extract from the raid.
  • Find an extraction point and successfully extract to finish the mission.
summary: Here is a thorough walkthrough for completing the 'A Lay of the Land' quest in Arc Raiders, covering how to find the shipping notes and the LIDAR scanners, and where to extract to turn in the quest.

title: A New Type of Plant
content:
To complete the "A New Type of Plant" quest, you need to find and gather a specific "Possibly Toxic Plant" located in the Dam Battlegrounds zone. This guide walks you through its exact location and how to easily turn in the quest item.

Step 1: Navigate to the Quest Zone

The quest takes place in the Dam Battlegrounds. Pull up your map to spot the general area marked as "Old Battleground" near the center of the map.

  • Look for the "Old Battleground" marker on your map within the Dam Battlegrounds region.
  • This area is characterized by large, crashed structures and dense foliage.

Step 2: Identify Plant Spawn Points

Once in the Old Battleground, go to the large, crashed structure that resembles a broken barn or facility.

  • The toxic plants usually spawn around the base of this massive, broken structure.
  • There are usually multiple spawn points very close to each other.
  • Keep an eye out for bright orange, somewhat spiky plants amidst the tall grass and debris.

Step 3: Gather the Plant

Move toward one of the identified toxic plants and use it to gather it.

  • Press the interaction button (usually 'E') when prompted to "Gather" the plant.
  • You only need one plant to turn in the mission.

Step 4: Secure and Turn In

After gathering the plant, open your inventory and place the "Possibly Toxic Plant" into your Safe Pocket.

  • Transfer the plant to your Safe Pocket to make sure it's not lost upon death.
  • To quickly turn in the mission just exfil and turn in
summary: This tutorial explains how to efficiently complete the "A New Type of Plant" quest in Arc Raiders by locating and gathering the "Possibly Toxic Plant" near the Old Battleground and turning it in.

Search for the new plant near the Baron Husk in the Old Battleground

title: A Reveal in Ruins
content:
Overview

The 'A Reveal in Ruins' quest asks you to find an ESR Analyzer inside a pharmacy in Buried City and deliver it to Lance. Pharmacies are not explicitly marked on your map, but they are usually found near metro stations. Here here are the exact locations of two pharmacies in Buried City where there is the analyzer.

Step 1: Pick Up the Quest from Lance

You must accept the 'A Reveal in Ruins' quest from Lance. He will task you with finding an ESR Analyzer inside a pharmacy in Buried City.

  • The quest objective is to find an ESR Analyzer inside any pharmacy in Buried City.
  • Lance offers rewards including a Tactical MIL 3 (Healing) augment and a Surge Shield Recharger.

Step 2: Find a Pharmacy in Buried City

There are two primary pharmacy locations in Buried City that are close to metro stations. These buildings are recognizable by a green cross symbol on their exterior.

First Pharmacy Location

The first pharmacy is close to a metro station.

  • Search nearby for a building with a green cross symbol, usually near a metro entrance.
  • On the map, this pharmacy is located north of Piazza Arlotto, near the Metro Entrance waypoint.
  • You must breach the door to enter.

Second Pharmacy Location

The second pharmacy is inside a different part of Buried City.

  • This pharmacy also has a 'Farmacia' sign and a green cross symbol on its exterior.
  • On the map, this pharmacy is in the southern part of Buried City, near Piazza Roma and the Main Street area.
  • Breach the door to gain entry to this building as well.

Step 3: Find and Secure the ESR Analyzer

Once inside a pharmacy, your job is to find the ESR Analyzer. It's often found on a counter or shelf.

  • Within the pharmacy, search nearby for a counter. The ESR Analyzer is a small, yellow device.
  • Use the device to pick it up.
  • CRITICAL: Immediately place the ESR Analyzer into your 'Safe Pocket'. This ensures you don't lose the item if you get knocked out or eliminated before returning to base.

Step 4: Deliver the ESR Analyzer to Lance

After you've successfully securing the ESR Analyzer in your Safe Pocket, you can head back to base and deliver it to Lance to finish the mission.

  • Even if you are knocked out during your run, the ESR Analyzer in your safe pocket will be retained.
  • Head back to Lance at your base.
  • Talk to Lance and select the option to deliver the ESR Analyzer to finish the mission and claim your rewards.

title: A Warm Place to Rest
content:
Overview

The 'A Warm Place to Rest' quest in Arc Raiders has you follow a series of clues leading to a specific location where there is a grave to inspect. Here we explain each step, from finding the initial camp to completing the quest.

Step 1: Go to the Abandoned Highway Camp

  • Pull up your map and find the 'Buried City' area.
  • Find the quest marker for 'A Warm Place to Rest' in the southwest region, in certain at the 'Abandoned Highway Camp'.
  • Head to this location.
  • When you get there, you will be on a ruined highway segment between two damaged buses.

Step 2: Follow the Red Markers

  • Near the front of one of the buses, you can find a backpack on the ground. interact with it to 'Search for any signs of survivors'.
  • This will trigger the next objective: 'Follow the red markers'.
  • Check your map again; new red markers will now be visible, leading you towards the 'Town Hall' area. Place a waypoint to guide you.
  • Begin following these red markers along the damaged highway.
  • Continue along the path, passing various wreckage and environmental hazards.
  • The markers will lead you off the highway and down a sandy slope towards some buildings.

Step 3: Inspect the Grave

  • As you walk toward the final marker, a notification to 'Inspect the grave' will appear.
  • Find the grave site among the rocks and debris.
  • Use the grave to complete the mission 'A Warm Place to Rest'.

title: After Rain Comes
content:
In this guide, we cover the steps to successfully complete the 'After Rain Comes' quest in Arc Raiders. The quest involves finding and repairing solar panels located near the Grandioso Apartments, requiring specific materials. You will need 5 Wires and 2 Batteries to repair the solar panels. You should bring them in with your loadout.

title: Armored Transports
content:
Overview

Finding the Armored Patrol Car can be challenging due to its random spawn locations. Here you'll see where to get the needed key and all potential spawn points for the locked patrol cars in the Traffic Tunnels, helping you successfully complete the associated quest.

Step 1: Get the Patrol Car Key

  • Start by heading to the 'Checkpoint' area on the Blue Gate map.
  • Continue to the most left guard house within the Checkpoint area.
  • Inside, on a table, you'll discover a folder. use it to get the 'Patrol Car Key'.
  • IMPORTANT: Place the Patrol Car Key into your safe pocket right after. Losing this key will prevent you from completing the quest unless you find it again.

Step 2: Search Traffic Tunnels for Patrol Cars

  • After you get the key, walk to the Traffic Tunnels. This area is easily accessible just along the main road from the Checkpoint.
  • The Armored Patrol Cars can spawn randomly throughout the tunnels. you must check different spots.

Possible Patrol Car Locations:

  • The first possible spawn is right at the entrance of the Traffic Tunnel.
  • Check behind each armored patrol car you come across. If the rear door is locked and requires the Patrol Car Key, you've found the correct one for your quest.
  • There are multiple spawn points deeper inside the tunnels. Consult your map for general areas.
  • Continue further into the tunnel, checking both sides of the road. Be aware of ARC drones, fireball paps, and Bastions in this area.
  • Another common spawn point is right next to a large pillar within the tunnel.
  • Continue to the very end of the tunnel, as additional patrol cars can spawn there.
  • Note: Not all armored vehicles are the quest-certain patrol car; some will just be junk vehicles or unlocked transports. Always look for the interaction prompt to use your Patrol Car Key on a locked rear door.

Step 3: Accessing the Patrol Car

  • When you find a patrol car with a locked rear door, use your Patrol Car Key to open it.
  • Inside, you'll discover weapon crates. grab these crates to receive a green or blue weapon, successfully completing the quest.
summary: This tutorial offers a walkthrough for finding the Armored Patrol Car and its key in Arc Raiders. Learn where to find the key and all possible spawn points for the patrol cars to complete your quest.

Step 1: Buried City Mural

title: Broken Monument
content:
The 'Broken Monument' quest requires you to find three specific items: a Compass, a Videotape, and Old Field Rations. All of these items are found within the Scrap Yard area of the Dam Battlegrounds map, each hidden in small, rusted metal crates. The order in which you collect them does not matter. As you move toward a quest item crate, a yellow pop-up will indicate "Search for [item name]".

Step 1: Prepare for the Quest

  • Load into the Dam Battlegrounds map.
  • Look at your map and find the Scrap Yard, which is situated at the southern end, almost in the center of the map, below the Research & Administration building.

Step 2: Find the Compass

  • Search for two large, gray metal containers that are stacked at an angle on top of one another, with three smaller red metal workbench-like structures in front of them.
  • Hop into the middle of these stacked containers.
  • You'll discover a rusted metal crate on the ground between the containers. Search it to get the Compass.

Step 3: Go to the Videotape

  • Scan for two long, green silos (large cylindrical containers) that are tipped over and lying next to each other.
  • On the side of one of these silos, you can find another rusted metal crate.
  • Open the crate to collect the Videotape.

Step 4: Go to the Old Field Rations

  • Head northeast out of the main Scrap Yard area. You will run into an old, abandoned mobile trailer-like structure.
  • Enter the trailer.
  • Inside, you'll discover a third rusted metal crate. Search it to collect the Old Field Rations.

Step 5: Important Completion Tips

  • Physical Collection Required: Unlike some other quests, you must physically pick up the quest items from the crates after searching. They will appear in your backpack.
  • One Round Only: All three quest items must be found and collected within a single raid round. The quest tracker explicitly states "within a single run".
  • Once all items are in your backpack, successfully extract from the raid to finish the 'Broken Monument' quest.
summary: This tutorial offers detailed instructions on how to complete the 'Broken Monument' quest in Arc Raiders by locating the Compass, Videotape, and Old Field Rations within the Dam Battlegrounds map. Learn where each item is hidden and critical tips for successful mission completion.

title: Building a Library
content:
Overview: Building a Library Quest

The 'Building a Library' quest asks you to find three certain books: a Tomebook, a Detectivebook, and an Adventurebook. All three are located within the Library building in Buried City.

Step 1: Head to the Library in Buried City

Pull up your map first and finding the Library icon within the Buried City zone. When you've marked it, go to the building. As you go in, you can find yourself in a large, somewhat dilapidated library structure.

Step 2: Find the Tomebook

  • The first book, the Tomebook, sits on the ground floor. After entering the main library area, search nearby for a fallen bookshelf near a large pile of scattered books.
  • Walk up to the bookshelf and engage to collect the Tomebook. [SCREENSHOT:00:13] Make sure you pick it up to progress the quest.

Step 3: Reach the Detectivebook

  • From the first book's location, head further into the ground floor, navigating around the debris. You'll notice another section with bookshelves lining the walls.
  • The second book, the Detectivebook, is on the ground near a bookshelf against a plain wall.
  • Collect the Detectivebook to add it to your inventory. [SCREENSHOT:00:25]

Step 4: Locate the Adventurebook

  • For the third book, the Adventurebook, you must go up to the second level of the library. Look for a staircase or ramp that leads upwards.
  • Once on the upper level, look over the railing. The Adventurebook is on a small shelf directly below the railing you're looking over. This one is often missed due to its position.
  • Go down to the lower level or find a safe way down to interact with and collect the Adventurebook. [SCREENSHOT:00:34]

Step 5: Deliver the Books

With all three books collected, your quest objective will update to 'Deliver Travels to Apollo'. You can now continue to Apollo to finish the 'Building a Library' quest.
summary: This guide goes over finding all three books required to finish the 'Building a Library' quest in Arc Raiders, located within the Buried City.

title: Celeste's Journals
content:
To complete the 'Eyes in the Sky' quest, you must find two distinct quest items located at certain outposts in the Dam Battlegrounds zone. In this guide, we cover finding both items and securing them for mission completion.

Step 1: First Quest Item (South Swamp Outpost)

The initial task is to go to the South Swamp Outpost. Pull up your map to spot its location.

  • Place a waypoint for the South Swamp Outpost, which is in the southern part of the map.
  • When you head over to the outpost, look for a dilapidated tower-like building.
  • Enter this wreckage building. Move through the dimly lit interior.
  • The quest item, referred to as 'Quest Objective', is found on top of a bed inside this building.
  • Make sure to grab the item and place it in your safe pocket to make sure it is not lost upon death.

Step 2: Second Quest Item (Raider Outpost East)

For your second item, your goal is to walk to the Raider Outpost East, located in the northern region of the map.

  • Check your map again and find the Raider Outpost East.
  • Move towards this location, which is nestled in a more arid, rocky landscape.

title: Clearer Skies
content:
Overview

The "Clearer Skies" quest has you destroying 3 ARC enemies and collect 3 ARC Alloy to deliver to Shani. This guide outlines the steps to efficiently complete this mission.

Step 1: Accept the "Clearer Skies" Quest

  • Access your Quests tab and find "Clearer Skies".
  • Review the objectives: Destroy 3 ARC enemies and Get 3 ARC Alloy for Shani.
  • Take on the quest to begin.

Step 2: Find and Destroy ARC Enemies

ARC enemies, usually drones for this quest, can be found throughout the map. You can actively look for them or wait for them to appear at certain points.

  • Identify an ARC drone in the environment.
  • Use a reliable weapon to shoot down the drone. Focus fire to destroy it quickly.
  • Confirm the drone has been destroyed.

Step 3: Collect ARC Alloy

Once an ARC enemy is destroyed, you must loot its remains to collect the required ARC Alloy.

  • Walk toward the downed ARC enemy and interact to search it.

Step 4: Use Extraction Elevators for Additional Enemies

A reliable method to come across ARC drones is by activating an extraction elevator, which almost always attracts a drone to your location.

  • Find an extraction elevator on the map.
  • Activate the elevator to initiate the extraction sequence.
  • An ARC drone will likely spawn and engage you near the elevator.
  • Destroy this drone and loot it for additional ARC Alloy if needed.

Step 5: Extract and complete the mission

After you get successfully collected 3 ARC Alloy, you must extract and head back to Shani to finish the mission.

  • Use an extraction elevator to head back to your base.
  • Hand over the collected ARC Alloy to Shani to finalize the "Clearer Skies" quest.

title: Communication Hideout
content:
In this guide, we explain the 'Communication Hideout' quest. you must find a missing battery cell, install it into a generator, power up the generator, and finally boost an antenna terminal.

Step 1: Find and Retrieve the Battery Cell

Begin your quest in Old Town, near the Red Tower. The Communication Hideout objective is highlighted on your map.

  • Travel to the specified location on your map, around here of Old Town near the Red Tower.
  • Look around for a small, dilapidated structure nestled in the sandy area near a wall.
  • Walk to the container located next to this structure.
  • Use the container to retrieve the missing battery cell.

Step 2: Power the Generator

After you get the battery cell, your next objective is to install it into the nearby generator and power it on.

  • Find the generator, which is a truck-like object with a blinking red light, situated on the cobblestone path near where you found the battery.

Step 3: Activate the Antenna Terminal

With power restored, your final task is to arrive at the antenna terminal on the Red Tower and boost it.

  • Walk over to the building next to the generator. you need to enter it until you reach the upper levels.

  • Reach the rooftop area and find a ladder.

Here here are the easiest locations to find Antiseptic, Syringes, and Great Mullin herbs to aid your survival and crafting needs in Arc Raiders.

Overview

To complete the 'Dormant Barons' quest, you need to find and interact with a specific type of structure known as a Barn Husk. This tutorial offers the exact location and steps to successfully loot it.

Step 1: Reach the Barn Husk

  • First, pull up your map to spot the general area. The Barn Husk sits at the breach on the Dam Battlegrounds. You can see the location on the map here:
  • When you head over to the Dam, look around for a large, overturned, metallic structure that is partially covered in vines. This is your Barn Husk. You can see it clearly from this vantage point:

content:

The 'Down to Earth' quest has you:

  • Visit a Field Depot
  • Deliver a Field Crate to a Field Depot
  • Collect the reward

Upon completion, you will be granted a Combat Mk 1 Augment and a Medium Shield.

Step 1: Head over to the Field Depot

This quest is most easily completed in the Dam Battlegrounds zone. Select 'Dam Battlegrounds' from the map selection screen and click 'Confirm'.

Once in the Dam Battlegrounds zone, find the Field Depot. A reliable location for a Field Depot is near the 'Electrical Substation' and 'Water Towers' area. You'll be looking for a building with a satellite dish on top.

The entrance to the depot is at ground level. Go inside the building.

Overview

The 'Finders Keepers' quest has you looting 3 containers in any Raider camp. Raider camps are not explicitly marked on your map, but there are certain locations you can visit to finish this objective easily.

Step 1: Find the Dam Raider Camp

One of the most reliable locations for finding Raider camp containers is the Dam. you can find this location on your map:

content:

content:
Overview

The 'From a Distance' quest has you ping a Bastion and a Rocketeer from a significant distance. The Spaceport map offers an excellent high vantage point that makes this quest straightforward and quick to complete.

Step 1: Select The Spaceport Map

  • Choose 'The Spaceport' as your destination for this mission. While other maps like Buried City also have these enemies, The Spaceport provides an ideal high-ground position.

title: Greasing Her Palms
content:
Greasing Her Palms Quest Overview

The 'Greasing Her Palms' quest has you visiting certain locations on three different maps: Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, and Spaceport. you must use a key for one location and breach barricades for another, before finally scoping out rocket thrusters. Completing this quest will grant you useful rewards.

Step 1: Dam Battlegrounds Objective

This part of the quest involves visiting the locked room in the Water Treatment Control building in the Dam Battlegrounds zone.

  • First, check your quest details in the menu to confirm the objectives and received items.
  • You will be granted a specific key for this part of the quest: the Dam Surveillance Key.
  • Make sure you place the Dam Surveillance Key into your Safe Pocket from your Stash before starting your raid to prevent losing it if you die.
  • Find the Water Treatment Control building on your map. It is a labeled building.
  • Go toward the building from the southwest. Look around for a gap between the buildings with stairs.
  • Go up the first flight of stairs and enter the door on your right.
  • Inside, you'll discover a locked door with a red keycard slot. Use your Dam Surveillance Key to open it. [SCREENSHOT:01:06]
  • Enter the opened room. There is often good loot inside, so make sure you have inventory space.

Step 2: Buried City Objective

For the Buried City objective, you must visit the barricaded room on the 6th floor of the Space Travel building.

  • Check your map and find the Space Travel building in Buried City. It is a labeled landmark.
  • After you get top-side in your raid, place a waypoint and walk to the building.
  • Go into the building via any accessible entrance and navigate to the 6th floor. [SCREENSHOT:01:39]
  • On the 6th floor, scan for barricaded doors. If another player has already been there, the doors may already be breached.
  • If the doors are barricaded, you must breach them to wrap up this objective.

Step 3: Spaceport Objective

The last segment of the quest is to scope out the rocket thrusters outside the Rocket Assembly building on the Spaceport map.

  • Go to the Spaceport map. Find the Rocket Assembly building on your map; it is a labeled location.
  • Once on the map, go toward the Rocket Assembly building.
  • Look for the large rocket thrusters lying on the side directly to the rear of the building.
  • Just approaching and standing near the thrusters will complete this objective.

mission completion

title: Into the Fray
content:
Overview

While Wolfpack grenades are a fast way to kill Leapers, they require looting. This tutorial offers an alternative strategy utilizing a specific choke point in the Spaceport area, allowing for consistent Leaper kills with less reliance on certain gear, and aiding in mission completion.

Step 1: Go to the South Trench Tower

  • Go to the Spaceport area on the map.
  • Find the South Trench Tower, which sits close to the 'The Trench' landmark. This tower has multiple broken windows that serve as entry and choke points.

Step 2: Access the Tower via Zipline

  • The most efficient way to get into the tower is by using a zipline.
  • Go toward the tower from the lower ground and look for an active zipline leading up to one of the broken windows.
  • Use the zipline to quickly climb and enter the tower through a broken window. This entry method provides an early warning system and positions you strategically.

Step 3: Set Up Your Choke Point

  • After entering, position yourself facing the broken window where you entered. This window will act as your primary choke point.
  • Optional: Place mines near the zipline entry point up on the roof. This prevents other players from easily flanking you if they attempt to use the same zipline.
  • The Leaper's only other way to reach you in this spot is via a key, making it a highly defensible position against both AI and potentially other players.

Step 4: Engage the Leaper

  • The Leaper will eventually walk toward the tower and attempt to enter through the broken window.
  • As it tries to squeeze through the opening, it will become an easy target. Focus your fire on its visible weak spots.
  • Maintain your position, using the wall as cover if needed, and continue to shoot until the Leaper is destroyed.

Step 5: Collect Leaper Parts & Complete Quests

  • When you've successfully destroying the Leaper, collect its remains.
  • You will often find useful Leaper Parts, which are essential for various quests in Arc Raiders.
  • This method is really good for quickly completing quests like 'Destroy a Leaper' due to the predictable nature of the fight in this location.
summary: This tutorial covers an easy and repeatable method to eliminate Leapers in Arc Raiders, centered on a specific choke point location. This strategy is perfect for farming Leaper parts for quests without relying on Wolfpack grenades.

title: Straight Record Quest
content:
Straight Record Quest Guide

Here we explain completing the "Straight Record" quest in the Dam Battlegrounds zone. Your objective is to find and shut down an old EMP trap by interacting with three specific power switches in a specific order, and then finally disabling the main EMP pole.

Step 1: Walk to the Quest Area

  • First, heading north in the Dam Battlegrounds zone, towards the area known as Victory Ridge.
  • The certain location for the quest will be marked on your map.

Step 2: Initiate the Quest

  • After you arrive at Victory Ridge, look for a tall EMP pole next to a large generator. It will have a distinctive yellow mission glow.
  • This is your starting point for the quest. Activate the EMP pole to begin.
  • You need to find and turn off three generator-type boxes. It's crucial to do them in a specific order, as interacting with the wrong box first will prevent further progress.

Step 3: Disable the First Power Switch

  • From the initial EMP pole, head directly north, up onto the ridge.
  • You'll see a power cable stretching out, leading to the first generator box.
  • Follow this cable and use the box to turn it off.

Step 4: Disable the Second Power Switch

  • Turn back around towards the main EMP pole.
  • Look to your left for a half-broken cement house.
  • Climb up to the second floor of this house.
  • From the second floor, look south, and you'll notice the second generator box at the end of what used to be a hallway. use it to turn off the switch.

Step 5: Disable the Third Power Switch

  • From the second generator's location, head south of the main EMP pole again.
  • Try to spot another telephone pole-like structure with a long black power cable hanging from it.
  • Follow this cable to arrive at the third and final generator box. use it to shut off the last switch.

Step 6: Shut Down the EMP Trap

  • Once all three power switches have been turned off, go back to the original EMP pole where you started the quest.
  • Use the main EMP pole to disable the trap and complete the "Straight Record" quest.
summary: A detailed walkthrough for finishing the "Straight Record" quest in the Dam Battlegrounds zone, which involves finding and shutting down an old EMP trap by activating three power switches in the correct order.

title: Aphelion Breakdown
content:
Overview

The Aphelion is a recently added Legendary Battle Rifle in ARC Raiders, known for its unique 'high velocity energy rounds'. At first perceived as underwhelming by some players, this weapon offers impressive stopping power, especially against ARC enemies, and can be very strong in PvP when used correctly. This guide goes over all the key details about the Aphelion, from its stats and best attachments to its strengths and weaknesses in different combat scenarios, and how to craft it.

Aphelion Overview & Acquisition

  • The Aphelion is a Legendary Battle Rifle firing high-velocity energy rounds.
  • It was at first an ultra-rare drop, but its blueprint drop rates have been much increased.
  • You get the Aphelion blueprint by collecting the core of the Matriarch when you defeat her.

Weapon Mechanics & Stats

  • The Aphelion fires in a 2-round burst mode.
  • It has a magazine size of 10 shots, meaning 5 bursts per magazine.
  • When firing, it consumes 2 ammo per 'click' (one burst).
  • Reloading the weapon consumes a single Energy Clip and fully recharges the magazine.
  • The weapon features 'Strong' ARC Armor Penetration and a special 'Experimental' trait.
  • It has high stopping power due to its high-velocity rounds, causing enemies to flinch and even flip.

Optimal Attachments

  • The Aphelion has noticeable recoil, mainly vertical. The first shot lands where aimed, while the second shot tends to go slightly up and to the left.
  • **Vertical Grip:** To mitigate the vertical recoil, a Vertical Grip is highly recommended. For instance, a Vertical Grip III much reduces vertical recoil by 44%.
  • **Stable Stock:** A Stable Stock (e.g., Stable Stock II) helps improve dispersion and recoil recovery time, allowing for quicker follow-up shots.
  • It is worth investing in attachments to improve the weapon's accuracy and control.

PvP Effectiveness & Playstyle

  • The Aphelion is very effective in PvP, especially at mid-range.
  • **Close Range:** Avoid direct close-range engagements as it can lead to issues due to the burst fire and recoil.
  • **Long Range:** It can be effective at long range if you crouch to reduce recoil further.
  • **Mid-Range Sweet Spot:** This is where the Aphelion truly shines. Play around cover, peeking to get your two-round burst off, then retreating to let the recoil reset.
  • **Time to Kill (Body Shots):**
  • **Light Shield:** 3 clicks (6 hits total).
  • **Medium Shield:** 3 clicks (6 hits total).
  • **Heavy Shield:** 4 clicks (8 hits total). Heavy shields offer significant resistance.
  • Playing around the burst delay, similar to using a shotgun like the Anvil, allows for effective peek-shooting tactics.
  • Combining the Aphelion with a close-range weapon (e.g., Venator, Vulcano, Stitcher) can compensate for its close-quarters combat weaknesses.

PvE Effectiveness (ARC Weaknesses & Strengths)

  • **Highs (Strengths):**
  • **Armor Stripping:** The Aphelion is excellent at stripping armor from ARC enemies, specificly flying types and certain components of larger ground units.
  • **Stopping Power:** Its high-velocity rounds cause flying enemies (Hornets, Wasps, Snitches) to flinch and flip, interrupting their attacks and leaving them exposed.
  • **Rocketeers:** It's considered one of the best weapons for dealing with Rocketeers due to its ability to disrupt their rocket fire.
  • **Turbines:** Effectively strips armor from Turbines, allowing for follow-up damage with other weapon types. Can also directly target their core.
  • **Leapers:** Can break apart Leaper legs and dismantle their core eye, rendering them non-functional.
  • **Lows (Weaknesses):**
  • **Raw Damage:** While excellent at stripping armor, the Aphelion lacks raw damage to quickly finish off stripped enemies compared to other energy weapons. Often requires switching to a different weapon for the killing blow.
  • **Bastions & Bombardiers:** These are the toughest targets. Breaking their joints or batteries takes too much effort with the Aphelion; a different caliber weapon is recommended for these targets once armor is stripped.
  • For general ARC killing, the Aphelion is best used in combination with a different gun that can finish enemies once their armor has been stripped and they are stunned.

Crafting the Aphelion

  • To craft the Aphelion, you first need to get its blueprint from the Matriarch's core.
  • You will also need Gunsmith Level 3.
  • The required resources are:
  • 3x Magnetic Accelerator
  • 3x Complex Gun Parts
  • 1x Matriarch Reactor
  • Acquiring the Matriarch Reactor is right now the most challenging part of crafting this weapon due to its rarity.
summary: Here is a comprehensive analysis of the Aphelion Legendary Battle Rifle in ARC Raiders, covering its stats, effectiveness against different enemy types (ARC and PvP), ideal playstyles, best attachments, and crafting requirements.
author: ARC Companion Team

title: Arc Survival Guide
content:
Overview

The PVE threats in ARC Raiders are many and can be deadly if you're unprepared. This guide goes over the best ways to take on each type of ARC enemy, centered on both easy and resource-efficient methods. We'll cover Hornets, Leapers, Rocketeers, ARC Surveyors, and Bombardiers, excluding the Queen as she deserves her own dedicated guide.

Step 1: Hornets

  • Threat Level: High
  • Armor Plate: Semi Plated
  • Primary Attack: Electric shock
  • Special Abilities: Stuns
  • Weakness: Rear thrusters
  • Health: 200

Killing a Hornet is like taking down a wasp: aim for the rotors. The front two rotors are armor-plated, so heavy ammo weapons will be more effective against them. If using light ammo, focus on the rear two rotors, though this can be tricky due to the angle.

Dodge Attacks:

  • Wait for the three yellow targeting lasers to combine into one.
  • They will flash red just before firing, which is your cue to perform a dodge roll.
  • Timing is key; spamming dodge roll is ineffective as they compensate.
  • A little distance can help, as closer attacks are harder to dodge.

Step 2: Leapers

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Leaps on you
  • Special Abilities: Releases kinetic energy
  • Weakness: Joints and its eye
  • Health: 1500

Leapers are exposed to tight spaces and fire. Blaze Grenades and Fireball Burners are viable choices.

Method 1: Grenades and Positioning

  • Bring about three Blaze Grenades or Fireball Burners.
  • Position yourself in buildings or bunkers where Leapers struggle to get through small doorways or reach you when indoors. For example, using bunkers on the Spaceport is always advised.

  • Aim to land grenades on the center eye-piece of the Leaper to spread fire to all three limbs.

Method 2 (Preferred): Blaze Grenade Trap & Jolt Mine

  • This method is easier and more resource-efficient.
  • A single Blaze Grenade Trap will shred a Leaper's armor.

  • Place a Blaze Grenade Trap, shoot the Leaper until it launches itself into the air, then take a few steps back.
  • Optionally, combine with a Jolt Mine for extra insurance to stun and keep the Leaper in the fire.

  • You can recycle Leaper Pulse Units for Advanced Mechanical Components as they're not often useful.

Step 3: Rocketeers

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Missile Barrage
  • Weakness: Thrusters (covered in armor plating)
  • Health: 1100

Rocketeers can be terrifying, but easy to defeat with the right strategy.

Recommended Weapon: Anvil

  • Anvil (Hand Cannon) is an easy-to-get heavy ammo weapon with a quick fire rate.

  • Approximately 40 rounds of heavy ammo should suffice.
  • Consider upgrading your Anvil to increase its fire rate.

Strategy: Distance and Thruster Focus

  • Before engaging, make sure you have ample cover, preferably inside a building or close to an entrance.

  • Start your attack from as far away as possible.
  • Aim for a single thruster. Taking out two thrusters will send the Rocketeer plummeting to the ground, often killing it outright if high enough.

  • Rocketeers are slow for a flying ARC, allowing you to kill them before they close distance.
  • Wolfpacks are really good but generally better saved for Queen fights.

Step 4: ARC Surveyor

  • Threat Level: Low
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Charges at Raider when provoked
  • Weakness: Exposes its core when transmitting
  • Health: Unknown

Surveyors are frustrating to chase. This method ensures a solo kill every time.

Recommended Items: Showstopper & Trigger 'Nades

  • You'll need one Showstopper grenade (looted, not crafted) and three Trigger 'Nades (craftable).

Strategy: Stun and Detonate

  • Sneak close enough to land a Showstopper grenade as your opening attack.

  • As soon as the Surveyor is stunned, switch to Trigger 'Nades and lay them on thick. Use all grenades while it's stunned.
  • Detonate all three Trigger 'Nades. This should be more thenough to destroy it.
  • If no Showstoppers are available, you might still land a couple of Trigger 'Nades before it flees, then finish it off with shots.
  • Bring a heavy ammo weapon like the Anvil for best impact if going without Showstoppers.

  • Loot any pieces that fall off the Surveyor, as they may contain useful ARC Notion Cores.

Step 5: Bastion

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: Full Plated
  • Primary Attack: Projectile
  • Weakness: Back panel, joints
  • Health: ~2000

The easiest method for Bastion requires teamwork.

Method 1 (Preferred - Team): Torrente & Ammo

  • You'll need a friend (or someone you can tolerate), a Torrente LMG, and a lot of medium ammo.

  • Setup: You and your partner should be on either side of the Bastion, with ample cover, preferably on raised ground.

  • Execution: Your friend fires the first shot to bait the Bastion's attention. Then, crouch to increase accuracy and aim for the small yellow canister on the rear armor plating.
  • Empty your magazine into its back while it's turned. This spot is unarmored.

  • Step back, reload, and wait for your friend to pull its attention again, then repeat.
  • You should kill it within three reloads of a Torrente.

Method 2 (Solo): Explosives

  • If solo, bring five or six Trigger 'Nades, Snap Blasts, or Heavy Fuse grenades.
  • Stick them to the Bastion itself each time its aim resets.

  • Trying to take down a Bastion solo with basic weaponry by shooting its knee joints is very risky and time-consuming, likely drawing hostile Raiders. Investing in explosives is better.

Step 6: Bombardier

  • Threat Level: Critical
  • Armor Plate: None
  • Primary Attack: Mortar Round
  • Special Abilities: Releases Kinetic Energy
  • Weakness: Back panel, joints
  • Health: Unknown

The Bombardier is lethal, with no armor plating on its main body, but its mortar fire is destructive.

Method 1 (Preferred - Solo): Trigger 'Nades & Shelter

  • You'll need five or six Trigger 'Nades.
  • Find a position to start throwing these grenades from while having a roof over your head. This makes it harder for the Bombardier to land shots.
  • Stick as many grenades as possible before it starts opening fire on you.

  • You can ignore the Spotter drones if you have overhead shelter.
  • Optionally, bring a Showstopper grenade to lock them in place for easier hits with Trigger 'Nades.

  • Investing in explosives is highly recommended for a quick solo kill.

Method 2 (Team): Distraction & Damage

  • Similar to the Bastion strategy, you need a friend willing to take its attention.
  • While your friend distracts, focus your damage on the unarmored rear canister.
  • Both players will need a sheltered building on either side of the Bombardier to make this work, which can be very certain and awkward to pull off.

title: ARC Weaknesses
content:
Overview

Understanding the unique weaknesses of each ARC enemy type can a lot improve your combat effectiveness. Here we go over specific strategies and preferred gadgets for neutralizing Leapers, Rocketeers, Bombadiers, Bastions, Wasps, and Hornets.

Step 1: Leaper - Fire Weakness

Leapers are highly susceptible to fire damage, which can quickly disable them.

  • When run intoing a Leaper, prepare to use fire-based consumables.
  • Select either a Blaze Grenade or a Blaze Rod from your inventory.
  • Throw the fire explosive at the Leaper. The fire will cause significant damage and often make the Leaper fall to the ground.
  • If it stands in the fire too long, it will be temporarily disabled and eventually destroyed.

Recommended: Blaze Grenades or Blaze Rods are very effective against Leapers.

Step 2: Rocketeer - Stun & Target or Heavy Weapons

Rocketeers can be tricky due to their aerial mobility, but they have distinct vulnerabilities.

  • When a Rocketeer appears, prepare a stunning explosive like a Hornet Driver or Showstopper Grenade.
  • Throw the stunning explosive at the Rocketeer to bring it down to the ground.
  • Once stunned, you have a 10-second window to get on top of the Rocketeer and shoot its thrusters for maximum damage.
  • Alternatively, for a quick and quiet takedown, use high-damage weapons like the Wolfpack or a Holecracker shot.

Recommended: Hornet Driver, Showstopper Grenade (for stun) or Wolfpack, Ferro Shots to the rotors (for direct damage).

Step 3: Bombadier & Bastion - Sticky Explosives or Knee Disabling

Both Bombadiers and Bastions share similar weaknesses, specificly to sticky explosives and specific tactical targeting.

  • Aim for the weak spot on their back. If you can get close enough without being aggroed, sticky grenades are ideal.
  • Use Snap Blast Grenades or Trigger Nades, which adhere to the enemy and deal explosive damage.
  • Another strategy involves damaging their knees. Continuously shoot their knees until they explode. This will temporarily disable them.
  • During the disabled state, unleash as much damage as possible with your weapons. They will not attack you during this brief window.
  • In scenarios with multiple ARC types, use Lure Grenades to make Bombadiers or Bastions fire their missiles at other ARC enemies, well making them fight each other.

Recommended: Snap Blast Grenades, Trigger Nades, and Lure Grenades.

Step 4: Wasp - Direct Body Shots

Wasps, while less threatening, can be aggressive and annoying. A direct move toward is often best.

  • If you spot a Wasp in the air and it's about to aggro on you, aim for its main body.
  • Shooting its main body is the most effective way to take it down quickly (e.g., three Anvil shots are usually enough).
  • Avoid shooting its thrusters, as this will destabilize it and make it fly around unpredictably, making it harder to hit while it continues to attack.

Step 5: Hornet - Front Plating Exploitation

Hornets can be taken down efficiently by centered on their armor plating.

  • When engaging a Hornet, instead of trying to hit the smaller back thrusters, focus on shooting the front plating.
  • After the front plating is shot down, it will expose the thruster directly behind it. Continue to fire through this opening.
  • This method allows you to hit two thrusters on one side with sustained fire, bringing the Hornet down much faster.

There are many effective ways to deal with ARC enemies, utilizing both your weapons and various gadgets available in the game. Experiment with different strategies, featuring the use of Horned Drivers or Wasp Drivers, to find what works best for you in different combat scenarios.

These specialized tools, whether crafted or found, can be powerful against ARCs, offering creative solutions beyond standard weapon fire.
summary: This guide outlines effective strategies and specific weaknesses for various ARC enemies finded in the game, helping you take them down efficiently.

title: Blue Gate Puzzles & Loot
content:
Overview

In this guide, we cover all the puzzles in the Blue Gate area, covering both surface and tunnel locations. Each puzzle requires certain actions, like inserting batteries or pressing buttons in a sequence, to unlock useful loot. Pay close attention to map markers and environmental clues to find these elusive objectives.

Step 1: Ancient Fort Puzzles

The first set of puzzles sits at the Ancient Fort. you need to find and insert three batteries into power stations to activate the loot. The batteries usually spawn on crates around the ruins.

  • Find the Ancient Fort on your map.
  • Start at the bottom-left corner of the fort ruins.
  • Pick up the first battery, usually found on crates.
  • Walk over to the first power station, following the black wires if needed.
  • Place the battery inside the power station.
  • Move to the second ruin building. [SCREENSHOT:01:45]
  • Find the second battery on a crate within these ruins.
  • Navigate to the second power station located along the wall, following the black wire.
  • Insert the second battery.
  • Go to the third power station, usually in the top floor. [SCREENSHOT:03:07]
  • Find the third battery, often in a dark room on a crate.
  • Insert the third battery into the power station.
  • Once all three batteries are inserted, the lights will turn green, indicating the loot is accessible in the basement.
  • Go down into the basement to collect your loot, usually found on a table or shelf.

Step 2: Raider's Refuge Puzzles

This location is known as a 'hot drop' due to high player traffic. Exercise caution. you must press four hidden buttons to unlock the basement loot.

  • Find Raider's Refuge on your map, near 'The Forest' region.
  • Find the first button on your left of the basement entrance, next to an AC unit.
  • Press the button to activate the first light. [SCREENSHOT:04:27]
  • Find the second button, often behind some wooden planks or debris to the right of the basement entrance.
  • Press the second button. [SCREENSHOT:04:52]
  • Head inside the main building structure and climb the ladder.
  • Find the third button on your left when you reach the top.
  • Press the third button.
  • The fourth button sits on the opposite side of the building's roof, near the communication tower. [SCREENSHOT:06:00]
  • Press the fourth button. [SCREENSHOT:06:12]
  • With all four buttons pressed, the lights at the basement entrance will turn green.
  • Go down into the basement (Secret Cellar) to collect your high-value loot.

Step 3: MANTIKOR (ARC Husk) Puzzles

There are two MANTIKOR locations on the map, both with similar puzzles involving power cells. This guide shows one version. you must find and install two power cells into the massive ARC husk.

  • Find the MANTIKOR husk on your map, near 'Checkpoint'.
  • Find power cells scattered around the dead ARC husk, usually on the ground.
  • Collect at least two power cells. [SCREENSHOT:07:00]
  • Climb up the side of the husk to the interior.
  • Find the first power cell slot and interact to insert a cell. This will trigger fire and loud noises, alerting other players.
  • Jump or climb to the opposite side to find the second power cell slot.
  • Insert the second power cell. [SCREENSHOT:07:38]
  • This completes the puzzle, opening a loot container near the power cell slots.

Step 4: Reinforced Reception Tunnel Puzzles

This puzzle is located within the tunnels, requiring you to follow colored lines and insert batteries. The batteries can sometimes glitch, so be patient.

  • Find the Reinforced Reception area on your map.
  • Enter the facility and find the main puzzle console.
  • Use the console; it will show a color (red, blue, or yellow) corresponding to lines on the floor.
  • Follow the indicated colored line to a specific door. [SCREENSHOT:09:00]
  • Find a battery located near the door you followed.
  • Place the battery inside the corresponding slot near the door.
  • Continue following the colored lines and repeating this process. There are usually three batteries to find.
  • Sometimes the batteries may be slightly glitched or hidden. Check corners, stairs, and small alcoves.
  • After inserting all batteries, go back to the main console area. A door will unlock, leading to the loot room.
  • Collect your loot, which often includes weapon crates and other valuables.

Step 5: Traffic Tunnel Puzzles

Another tunnel puzzle, similar to the Reinforced Reception, but potentially more combat-heavy.

  • Find the 'Traffic Tunnel' on your map, often indicated by a supply beacon.
  • Follow the colored lines (red, blue, yellow) on the floor, similar to the previous tunnel puzzle. [SCREENSHOT:11:30]
  • Use the console to reveal the color sequence.
  • Follow the yellow line down the zipline.
  • Find and insert the batteries into their designated slots along the path.
  • Be aware of potential enemy come acrosss, as this area can be noisy and attract attention. [SCREENSHOT:11:55]
  • Once all batteries are in place, the path to the loot room will be open. [SCREENSHOT:12:05]
  • Collect your rewards from the weapon crates and other containers.
summary: This tutorial covers all puzzle locations and how to solve them in the Blue Gate area of Arc Raiders, featuring surface ruins and underground tunnels, to maximize your loot.

title: Cash Farming Guide for Expedition
content:
Overview: Expedition Requirements

To maximize skill points for your next Raider in the upcoming expedition (deadline December 22nd), you must accumulate 5 million in stash value. This tutorial offers strategies to achieve that goal quickly by both minimizing losses and maximizing gains.

Minimizing Losses

Before centered on making money, it's crucial to understand how to stop losing it. Every item used or lost in a raid represents a decrease in your overall stash value.

Avoid Overspending on Raids

  • Every bullet fired, every bandage used, and every broken shield costs money. Going into a raid with expensive gear means a higher potential loss if you die or use up your supplies.
  • Run with minimal loadouts: Start with a basic or 'free' loadout. If you extract successfully, you've gained resources without risking your useful stash. If you die, the loss is negligible.

Rethink Weapon Crafting & Upgrades

  • Crafting weapons and fitting them with attachments actually diminishes their overall value compared to the raw crafting materials.
  • Sell crafting materials directly: The base materials required to craft weapons and attachments are often worth more than the completed items. Avoid crafting unless you in specific need the item for a run.

Beware of Resource Sinks

  • Certain activities and enemies can be massive drains on your resources with minimal reward.
  • Avoid the Queen and Matriarch: These enemies require a significant amount of ammo and medical supplies to defeat. The grab they drop often doesn't justify the resources expended.
  • Move toward PvP strategically: If you engage in player-versus-player combat with an expensive loadout, you risk losing major value. Consider running cheaper loadouts for PvP run intos to minimize potential losses.

Maximizing Gains

When you've minimized your losses, you can focus on efficient money-making strategies.

Stella Montis Runs

  • Stella Montis is an excellent choice for consistent profit due to its constant availability and high-value loot containers.
  • Target specific areas: Focus on the Assembly Workshop, Medical Research, and Lobby areas.
  • Loot containers: Search all containers in these high-density loot zones. You can quickly accumulate 50-80k in value within a few minutes.
  • Minimal entry: Go in with just a hatch key in your safe pocket to minimize risk. If you die, you've only lost a couple of minutes of your time. If you extract, you have a backpack full of items to sell.

Lush Blooms Event

  • This event spawns fruit baskets around the map, offering significant value that can stack in your inventory.
  • Find locations: Use online maps like Metaforge to recognize fruit basket spawn locations, especially on larger maps like Spaceport.
  • Collect fruit: Fruit items stack, allowing you to carry a large amount of value per run.
  • Be cautious: Lush Blooms can attract other players, making it a riskier play than Stella Montis.

Queen Harvester (Specific Strategy)

  • While fighting the Queen directly is generally inefficient, a specific strategy can yield profit.
  • Low loadout move toward: Go in with a cheap loadout to minimize risk.
  • Target the harvester puzzle: Complete the Queen Harvester puzzle and grab the breachable containers inside. These often contain ARC parts and energy ammo.
  • Shoot legs and escape: If you have time and the Queen is not heavily contested, you can shoot off her legs for additional loot, then wait for her to de-aggro and escape via a nearby Raider hatch (Dam Battlegrounds is a good spot for this).

High-Density Loot Locations (Day Raids)

  • Certain buildings across various maps are packed with containers, providing consistent value.
  • Dam Battlegrounds: Focus on Research & Administration for many lootable containers.
  • Spaceport: The Departure Building and Arrival Building have multiple floors filled with containers for quick looting.
  • Buried City: The Plaza Rosa area, Grandioso Apartments, Space Travel, and Research buildings are excellent for finding abundant loot.
  • Use Day Raids: Running these maps during the day often has less competition from other players who might be focused on night raids for rare blueprints.

ElectroMagnetic Storm Event

  • During an electrostorm, ARC Husks and Probes appear, offering decent loot with less player competition.
  • Loot ARC Husks and Probes: These yield ARC parts and other useful components.
  • Spaceport Advantage: Spaceport is often ideal due to the large, open areas where these spawns usually occur.
  • Metaphorge map: Use online tools like the Metaphorge map to recognize the spawn locations for ARC Husks.
  • Consistent profit: Depending on luck, you can make 80-100k per run, potentially 200-300k/hour if you get rare drops like Rocketeer Drivers.
summary: This tutorial covers efficient methods to accumulate wealth in Arc Raiders, centered on maximizing profit and minimizing losses, essential for the upcoming expedition.

title: Glitched Queen Insta-Kill
content:
Overview

Here we go over the fastest method to defeat the 'Queen' boss netting you a massive 48,000 XP per kill. The strategy relies on precise placement of Blaze Grenade Traps and an Anvil weapon for easily shooting them. While possible solo, it's safer with a teammate to guard against third parties.

Step 1: Preparation

  • You will need two Blaze Grenade Traps for this method. Make sure they are the 'Traps' and not regular 'Grenades'.
  • Blaze Grenade Traps can be found during free loadout runs or by surrendering repeatedly until you get them.
  • It's highly recommended to bring a Raider's Key, as it helps with extraction.
  • Playing in a duo or trio is advised to protect against other players, as solo runs can easily be third-partied.

Step 2: Locating the Queen

The Queen sits on any map, but this guide demonstrates the process on the Blue Gate map. It's crucial to recognize the Queen's location early in your raid.

  • Check your map to find the Queen's general area. look for 'Harvester' on your map.
  • Walk over to the Queen's location, being mindful of your surroundings and potential enemy players.
  • As you move toward, observe the Queen's movement. It usually rotates in a circular pattern.
  • The primary threat around the Queen is often the 'Rocketeer', so make sure it's not directly in your path or moving away.

Step 3: Approaching and Placing Traps

The key to this strategy is to walk toward the Queen without aggroing it and correctly placing your traps.

  • Walk over to the Queen from behind or a side where it won't detect you. Since it rotates, you can usually stay out of its line of sight.
  • Eliminate any nearby Wasps (flying drones) that could compromise your stealth. A suppressed weapon is recommended.
  • Find the specific weak spot on the underside of the Queen's body. You'll want to place the traps directly into this area.
  • Put your Blaze Grenade Traps into your quick-use slots for easy access. Consider moving them to your 'Safe Pocket' in case you die, to retain them.
  • Carefully climb up to the Queen's body.
  • Place the first Blaze Grenade Trap so it is lodged inside the Queen's body, not falling to the ground.
  • Place a second Blaze Grenade Trap in the same manner. This ensures maximum damage and a one-shot kill.

Step 4: Executing the Kill

After the traps are placed, a single shot will detonate them and initiate the kill.

  • Once both traps are in place, aim your Anvil weapon at the traps and fire.
  • The traps will ignite, causing massive damage to the Queen. There is a large fire and an explosion effect.
  • Watch for the XP notification on your left of your screen, confirming you've received 48,000 XP.

Step 5: Loot and Extraction

When you've successfully taking down the Queen, it's time to collect your rewards and safely extract.

  • Go toward the fallen Queen and loot all the useful items from its core. Make sure you loot everything for additional XP.
  • Be extremely cautious during looting, as the sound of the Queen's demise will attract other players.
  • Head to a nearby extraction point, such as the Checkpoint or Raider's Hatch, depending on your team's key status.
  • The guide shows heading to a nearby petrol station to regroup and prepare for extraction.
  • Remain vigilant for other players who may be lurking around extraction zones.
  • Successfully extract from the raid, securing your XP and useful loot.
summary: This guide shows you how to quickly and easily defeat the 'Queen' boss using Blaze Grenade Traps to gain 48,000 XP in just a few minutes. Learn the ideal placement and strategy to avoid aggro and secure your loot.

title: Hidden Bunker Event Location Spaceport
content:
Overview: Hidden Bunker Event

The Hidden Bunker event in Spaceport is an ongoing puzzle that requires activating multiple antennas across the map to open a secret bunker. Inside, players can download data from consoles for XP, with a possible deeper puzzle involving coordinated activation.

Step 1: Activating the Antennas

The first stage of the Hidden Bunker event involves activating four antennas located across the Spaceport map. Each antenna must be activated to successfully open the bunker.

  • Find the bunker entrance, usually in a set location on the map.
  • When a match loads with the Hidden Bunker event, four antennas will appear around the map.
  • It's recommended to start by activating the antennas in the furthest corners of the map and gradually work your way towards the antenna closest to the bunker entrance.
  • To activate an antenna, you must climb to its rooftop. Many antennas are inaccessible without a zipline.
  • Make sure your Utility Bench is upgraded to Level 2 to craft ziplines. You'll need rope for this.
  • After reaching the rooftop, find and activate the data console. [SCREENSHOT:01:23]
  • After activating the console, a wave of ARC enemies (wasps, hornets, rocketeers) will spawn. Be prepared with healing items like Wolfpacks.
  • Allow the data download to complete, then use the console again to finalize the process.
  • Repeat this process for all four antennas across the map. After the last antenna is activated, a message will appear indicating the 'Hidden Bunker is Now Open'.

Step 2: Accessing the Hidden Bunker

Once all four antennas are activated, the hidden bunker entrance will be accessible. To the left of the departure building. A dash to the bunker will be needed, as other players might also be heading there.

  • Go toward the bunker entrance as quickly as possible.
  • Be aware of potential PvP run intos, as multiple players will likely be rushing to the bunker.
  • The area around the bunker entrance may be guarded by enemies like Bombardiers and Bastions. One specific Bastion has been observed shooting through walls, which might be a bug. Try to avoid engaging it directly if possible.

Step 3: Data Downloads and Potential Secrets

Within the bunker, there is a circular layout with several data consoles. Each console offers an XP reward for downloading data, but there's an ongoing community theory about a deeper puzzle.

  • Go through the circular corridors of the bunker.
  • There are about seven or eight data consoles inside the bunker.
  • To start a data download, use a console. You must 'Stay close to continue download'. If you move away, the download will fail.
  • Upon successful completion, the console will briefly display a green light and award you 500 XP.
  • If you leave the console before the download is complete, it will get a red light and reset, allowing you to try again.
  • **Community Theory:** It is theorized that activating all data consoles simultaneously with multiple players might unlock a secret area or trigger a special event.
  • This requires significant coordination, ideally with 7-8 players, each standing by a console and activating it at the exact same time (e.g., at a specific countdown timer mark). Due to potential glitches or timing issues, this can be challenging to execute.

Important Considerations and Tips

  • **Zipline Usage:** Always place ziplines at the very top of buildings to avoid falling.
  • **Zipline Collisions:** Avoid riding a zipline if another player is already on it, as collisions can lead to elimination.
  • **Bunker Loot:** The bunker contains many lootable containers, featuring weapon and ammo crates.
summary: Here is a thorough walkthrough for activating the hidden bunker event in Spaceport, featuring antenna activation, accessing the bunker, and understanding the data download consoles inside. It also covers tips for dealing with enemies and navigating the environment.

title: How to beat the Matriarch - NEW BOSS
content:
Overview

The Matriarch is the latest boss in Ark Hunters. It's an aggressive boss with more attack patterns than the Queen, but surprisingly, it seems to have less health, making it defeatable with less ammo if you are prepared. Here we explain the best strategies and loadouts to take it down.

Step 1: Recommended Loadout

  • Primary Weapon: Hullcracker is highly recommended for its damage efficiency.
  • Ammo: Bring about 140 Hullcracker ammo.
  • Shield: Use a heavy shield. This will reduce your loot space but is crucial for survival.
  • Medkits: Prioritize bringing more medkits than ammo, as the Matriarch's attacks can be very damaging.
  • Team: Fighting with a squad is always easier.

Step 2: Understanding Matriarch Attack Patterns

Homing Missiles

  • This is the most dangerous attack. The Matriarch constantly fires barrages of fast-moving homing missiles.
  • Strategy: Stand behind any piece of solid cover. Be aware of some AoE damage and that missiles can sometimes curve around corners. Pick your cover wisely to avoid being hit.

Gas Mines

  • The Matriarch sends out barrages of gas mines.
  • Being in the gas will cause your character to cough uncontrollably, disabling your ability to fire. [SCREENSHOT:01:54]
  • Strategy: Avoid the gas at all costs. While it doesn't appear to deal direct damage, the debuff is detrimental to combat.

Flashbangs

  • The Matriarch can fire flashbang-like projectiles.
  • Standing near these will temporarily blind you, which is not ideal in combat.
  • Strategy: If you see one, run away to avoid the blinding effect.

Summoned ARC

  • The Matriarch will call in waves of other ARC units.
  • Rocketeer: This is often the main threat among the summoned units and can deal significant damage.
  • Bastion: Bastions can pin you down and prevent you from looting after the Matriarch is defeated.
  • Strategy: Prioritize eliminating summoned ARC units, especially Rocketeers and Bastions, to prevent being overwhelmed or losing out on loot.

Impenetrable Shield

  • The Matriarch periodically deploys a large, impenetrable blue shield.
  • Strategy: You cannot damage the Matriarch while this shield is active. Wait until the shield dissipates before resuming your attack.

Step 3: Combat Strategy

  • Utilizing Cover: Always prioritize cover to avoid missile barrages and other attacks. Find thick cover that blocks AoE damage and curving projectiles.
  • Targeting Weak Points: The Matriarch's biggest weak point is its red core located in its head. Consistently shooting the head will expose this core.
  • You can also target the legs, which have armor plating, but once that's broken, they take damage quickly.
  • Map Choice: Dam Battlegrounds is generally considered the best map for fighting this boss due to ample cover and strategic positions. Blue Gate is not recommended due to inenough cover.

Step 4: Loot & Rewards

  • The main loot dropped by the Matriarch is the Matriarch Reactor.
  • This legendary item is used to craft the new Energy Burst Rifle (Battle Rifle).
  • Make sure you secure your loot quickly after defeating the Matriarch, as lingering enemy units like Bastions can still pose a threat and prevent collection.


Credit to The Gaming Merchant for the screenshots used in this guide.
summary: This tutorial offers a comprehensive strategy for defeating the Matriarch boss, featuring recommended loadouts, understanding its attack patterns, identifying weak points, and tips for efficient combat and loot collection.

Dog Collar

Lemon & Apricot

Mushrooms

  • look for them growing on pipes near the Water Treatment Control building.

  • You'll notice them growing on trees in the Scrapyard and Wreckage areas.
  • For the most consistent mushroom farming, go to the Spaceport map.
  • Find this specific spot near the East Container Yard and Rocket Assembly.
  • This area has trees with guaranteed mushroom spawns, making it ideal for farming.

Prickly Pear

  • These cacti fruits are found on the ground alongside cacti.
  • A good spot in the Dam Battlegrounds zone is around Pattern House.
  • Look closely among the cacti for the fruits to harvest.
  • Alternatively, you'll notice prickly pears in Buried City.
  • They are often scattered around the Plaza Riva area.

Very Comfortable Pillow & Cat Bed

  • Keep searching all residential containers; they may seem rare at first but are plentiful.
  • For example, in Buried City, loot all buildings in the Plaza Rosa area.

Step 2: Gunsmith Items

Rusted Tools & Advanced Mechanical Components

  • These items are frequently found by breaching vehicles.
  • Go to the Checkpoint and Highway Collapse areas on the Blue Gate map.
  • Breach all the abandoned cars in these locations. Rusted Tools are common, and Rusted Gear has a small chance to drop.
  • For Advanced Mechanical Components, your best bet is breaching server cabinets found in almost any building across all maps.
  • For Rusted Tools, look for rusted toolboxes and red lockers in industrial areas.

Wasp Driver

  • To get a Wasp Driver, you must eliminate a Wasp.
  • grab the Wasp's body after defeating it.

Sentinel Firing Cores

  • Sentinels (the spider-like turrets) drop these.
  • in the Dam Battlegrounds zone during a Night Raid, there is a Sentinel at the Research & Administration area, on the blue stairs outside the building.
  • Another Sentinel is situated at The Breach.
  • There's often one here as well. Night Raids on Dam Battlegrounds provide the best chance for these drops.

Step 3: Gear Bench Items

Electrical Components

  • Electrical Components can be crafted using the Refiner if you have the blueprint.

  • Alternatively, search server cabinets which are abundant across all maps in industrial and electrical zones.
  • These containers often yield electrical components.

Hornet Driver

  • Eliminate a Hornet to get a Hornet Driver.
  • Loot its body after defeating it.

Power Cables

  • Power Cables sits in various loot containers.

  • collecting these containers frequently yields Power Cables.

Industrial Batteries

  • Industrial Batteries have a high chance of spawning in industrial areas.

Advanced Electrical Components

  • These advanced components can be found or crafted.
  • One method is to solve the Ancient Fort puzzle quest on the Blue Gate map, leading you underground to find them.
  • Alternatively, walk to the Reinforced Reception area on the Blue Gate map.
  • Solve the underground puzzle by inserting three batteries to open a large door.
  • Inside, you'll spot a control room with many Advanced Electrical Components on the computers.

Bastion Cell

  • Bastion Cells come from Bastions, you should get anywhere from 2-4 per kill. Theres a full arc killing guide here that explains more strategies to taking all enemies down.

Step 4: Medical Lab Items

ARC Alloy

  • ARC Alloy is dropped by any defeated ARC enemy.
  • Just eliminate any ARC and grab their remains.

Cracked Bioscanners

  • Cracked Bioscanners are often found in medical facilities.
  • The Hospital in Buried City is a prime location.
  • look for them frequently spawning on top of the hospital beds rather than inside containers.

Durable Cloth

  • Durable Cloth sits in any container across Arc Raiders.
  • It's also easily crafted using the Refiner from Fabric.

Rusted Shut Medical Kit

  • These kits is in pretty much any container.
  • For a higher chance, examine the Hospital in Buried City.
  • The Hospital is a good general source for medical supplies.

Antiseptic

  • Antiseptic sits in various containers, especially medical ones.
  • A consistently great spot is the pharmacy building in Plaza Rosa, Buried City.
  • Examine the store shelves on the ground floor of this breachable building for a high yield.

Surveyor Vault

  • To get a Surveyor Vault, you must track down and defeat a Surveyor.
  • Look around for a large blue beam of light in the sky at the start of a match; this indicates a Surveyor's location.
  • Bring powerful weapons like a Wolfpack or Showstopper, as Surveyors tend to roll away. Loot it after destruction.

Step 5: Refiner Items

ARC Power Cells

  • Any ARC enemy will drop ARC Power Cells upon defeat.
  • Just eliminate and loot ARCs to collect these.

Toasters

  • Toasters are usually found in residential areas.
  • Search any residential container, such as wardrobes and drawers, in locations like Buried City.

ARC Motion Cores

  • These cores are dropped only by specific ARC enemies.
  • They can drop from the Leaper, Queen, Rocketeer, Bastion, or Surveyor.
  • You can also get them by looting ARC husks.
  • The Old Battleground area in the Dam Battlegrounds zone is a good place to find many ARC husks to breach.

Bombardier Cell

  • Defeat a Bombardier to get a Bombardier Cell.
  • Loot its parts after eliminating it.

Step 6: Utility Station Items

Damaged Heat Sinks

  • Damaged Heat Sinks are found in server cabinets.
  • These cabinets are scattered across all maps in most buildings.
  • The Power Generation Complex underground section in the Dam Battlegrounds zone is a notable spot.

Electrical Components

  • Electrical Components can be crafted at the Refiner using Rubber Parts and Plastic Parts.
  • Alternatively, you can recycle Wasp or Hornet Drivers to get them.

Snitch Scanner

  • To get a Snitch Scanner, you must defeat a Snitch.
  • Snitches are the ARC enemies that emit a large search beam of light. Shoot them three times with an anvil to destroy them, then loot.

Fried Motherboards

  • Fried Motherboards are found in electrical containers.

Leaper Pulse Units

  • Eliminate a Leaper enemy to get Leaper Pulse Units.
  • grab the Leaper's body after defeating it.

Step 7: Expedition Items

Synthesized Fuel

  • Synthesized Fuel sits in cars and residential loot containers.
  • For an easier method, visit Celeste at the Traders and buy them using Assorted Seeds.

Crude Explosives & Pop Triggers

  • These items are often found together in explosive-related areas.
  • Eliminate Pops (fireball enemies) and Fireball Burners found underground on any map.
