Laboratory Reagents

  • Laboratory Reagents are rare crafting items.
  • The pharmacy building in Plaza Rosa, Buried City, on the ground floor shelves, is a reliable place to find them.

Explosive Compound

  • Explosive Compound is commonly found in areas with high explosive density.
  • [SCREENSHOT:10:34] Walk to the underground section of Reinforced Reception on the Blue Gate map.

Rocketeer Driver

Steel Springs

  • Many items can be recycled into Steel Springs using the Refiner.

Cooling Fan

  • Cooling Fans are usually found in server cabinets.

Exodus Modules

  • Exodus Modules are certain to the Spaceport map.
  • Go to the Rocket Assembly area and loot all industrial containers, especially the red lockers.

Light Bulbs

  • Light Bulbs is in practically any loot container.

Sensors

  • Sensors are found in server cabinets.

Batteries

  • Batteries are very common and sits in most containers.

Humidifier

  • The Humidifier is a random loot item.

Motor

  • Motors are mainly found by breaching cars.
  • They have a very low chance, similar to Rusted Gear, but persist in breaching cars in areas like Highway Collapse.

title: Is the security breach skill worth it?
content:
⚔️ Worth the Points? A Deep Dive into the ARC Raiders Security Breach Skill and Epic Loot Locations

In ARC Raiders, the skill tree presents players with tough choices, but few skills are as mysterious—and potentially rewarding—as the Security Locker Breach Skill. It demands a significant investment of your limited skill points, making many wonder: is it truly worth sacrificing other crucial upgrades like increased stamina or faster movement?

The short answer, according to The Gaming Merchant, is a resounding yes—the skill is extremely worthwhile, acting as one of the fastest routes to geting end-game weaponry.

Here is a breakdown of the commitment required, the powerful loot you can expect, and a guide to the key security locker locations.

The Skill Tree Investment Dilemma

Acquiring the Security Locker Breach Skill requires committing a significant portion of your skill points early on.

  • The Cost: Maxing out a single skill tree requires 36 points (or 36 levels). Since the maximum number of skill points available is only 75, unlocking the breach skill early means you will have to forgo other foundational skills like better stamina and faster movement for a period.
  • The Warning: If you invest in this skill too soon, you will struggle with basic movement, and may need to bring 10 to 15 adrenaline syringes per raid just to compensate for the lack of stamina skills.
  • The Long-Term Plan: The ideal path is to unlock the Security Breach skill and then use the remaining points to pick up the essential stamina skills at the bottom of the other trees, rather than trying to max out another tree entirely.

What's Inside? The Epic Loot Breakdown

The key to the skill's value is the high-tier, consistent loot found within the security containers. These are essentially weapon lockers that drastically reduce the need for crafting high-level gear.

Security lockers are consistently filled with:

  • Guaranteed High-Tier Weapons: The weapons found are always Level 2 and you will never find common weapons.
  • Epic Tier Weapons: You can expect to find highly desirable epic tier weapons regularly, featuring:
  • The Bobcat
  • The Patina (arguable the best gun in the game)
  • The Tempest
  • The Volcano shotgun
  • Other weapons like the Ventor, Anvil, El Toro, and Torren
  • Essential Crafting Components: The lockers frequently contain parts crucial for upgrading your weapons, such as:
  • Heavy Gun Parts
  • Light Gun Parts
  • Complex Gun Parts
  • Other Gear: Grenades, ammo, and useful blueprints are also part of the loot pool.

Crucially, the loot pool appears to be consistent across all maps, meaning no matter where you are, a security locker provides the same chance at great loot. Also, the loot from these security lockers was observed to be much better than loot found behind locked doors that require a key.

🗺️ Security Locker Locations Guide

The video highlighted several locations where you can consistently find security lockers across different maps:

The Dam

  • Breached Room Location: Look for a breached door in the dam area (this was done on a normal, not night, raid). This spot is considered one of the best in the game for security lockers. The path involves running alongside the top level of the floodgates area, turning right, finding doors leading down to the overlook, sliding down, and opening the drawbridge to cross.
  • Power Complex: In the power generation complex underground, you'll notice a locker out in the open. This location is riskier as it is a common player area and you don't have to breach a door for cover.

Bluegate

  • Under the Church: There is a security locker that asks you to input four buttons to open the room.
  • Underground Area: Another one is in the Bluegate underground area, one floor above the Bluegate locked door.

Spaceport

  • Locked Bunkers: Lockers are spread out in the small bunkers across the spaceport. These usually have breachable doors on the outside.
  • Tip: You can often peek through the open window of the bunkers to check if the lockers are inside, saving you the time of breaching the door.

Buried City

  • Locked Room: At least one security locker has been found in a locked room within Buried City.

The security breach skill is an investment, but the ability to consistently grab Level 2 epic weapons makes it a core component of any loadout focused on end-game progression.
summary: "..the skill tree presents players with tough choices, but few skills are as mysterious—and potentially rewarding—as the Security Locker Breach Skill"

title: Paving the Way Quest
content:
This guide goes over the 'Paving the Way' quest in The Cycle: Frontier, outlining the locations and interactions required to finish the mission.

  • Head toward the building from the southwest side.

title: Stella Montis Overview and Looting Guide
content:
Overview: Stella Montis Map

Stella Montis is a new, high-risk, high-reward map in Arc Raiders

Medical Research (Red Tier)

The Medical Research area is a Red Tier zone offering significant loot but also high PvP action. Expect frequent player finds and challenging enemies.

  • High PvP Run intos: You will face aggressive players. Be ready for combat at all times.
  • New ARC: Shredders: This area introduces new ARC enemies called Shredders. They are dangerous and can quickly deplete your health. Aim for their blue thrusters for critical damage.
  • Looting Useful Items: Look out for trash cans and other containers. They often contain high-value crafting materials and keys, like the Buried City Town Hall Key.
  • Always be Cautious: Even if players call out as friendly, be wary. Many will attack without warning.
  • Loot Value: After 3 successful runs, the total loot value was about 208K credits.

Assembly Workshops (Yellow Tier)

Despite being a Yellow Tier area, Assembly Workshops offer surprisingly high-quality loot, making it a very lucrative spot, but also highly contested.

  • Epic Rarity Loot: Expect to find many epic rarity crafting materials and good weapons.
  • Intense PvP: This area is a hotspot for player-versus-player combat. Be prepared for constant engagements.
  • Speeding Up Runs: Bringing a Radar Hatch key can help you quickly access certain areas and extract faster.
  • Loot Value: After 2 successful runs (before an unfortunate death), the loot value was 172K credits.

Seed Vault (Red Tier)

The Seed Vault is a Red Tier area, but it's unique in its offerings and playstyle.

  • Only Seeds: This area is mainly for collecting seeds, a crafting material for the seed vendor.
  • Time-Consuming: There are over 500 containers, each yielding only a few seeds. It's a slow and tedious process.
  • Low PvP: Due to the low-value, high-effort loot, players are generally more friendly here, making it a calmer experience. [SCREENSHOT:11:00]
  • Overall Assessment: Not recommended for quick money making. It's more for specific crafting needs or a relaxed vibe.

Cultural Archives (Red Tier)

Cultural Archives is another Red Tier zone, but its loot profile differs from Medical Research.

  • Trinkets and Blueprints: This area mainly offers trinkets and a small chance for blueprints.
  • Low Value Loot: Most containers will yield only fabric and plastic parts, making it less profitable than other Red Tier zones.
  • Friendly Come acrosss: Similar to the Seed Vault, the low-value loot means less competition, often leading to friendly player interactions.

Lobby (Yellow Tier)

The Lobby is a Yellow Tier area that can be surprisingly lucrative if you know where to look.

  • Mantikor Room: On Floor 3, the room marked 'Mantikor' is often filled with high-tier loot and fuel canisters.
  • Strategic Fuel Canister Use: Fuel canisters can be thrown to create explosions, useful against groups of enemies.
  • Overall Assessment: A great place to stop by for useful loot if it hasn't been cleared, offering high risk and high reward.

General Stella Montis Strategy

Success on Stella Montis requires more than just knowing loot spots; it demands tactical awareness and adaptability.

  • PvP Awareness is Key: This map is a PvP fest. Always be ready for combat, even if players seem friendly.
  • Clear the Aggressors: If you eliminate the aggressive PvP players early in a raid, fewer new players will spawn in, potentially leaving you with a calmer looting experience.
  • Spawn Point Strategy: Unlike other maps, players spawn directly into Point of Interests (POIs) on Stella Montis. This means you must loot whatever is closest to your spawn quickly before other players get to it.
  • High Risk, High Reward: The best loot is often in the most dangerous areas. Decide if the potential reward is worth the risk.
summary: This guide identifies the most profitable looting zones and key strategies for survival and wealth accumulation on the Stella Montis map in Arc Raiders.

title: Trials 3 Star Guide
content:
Weekly Trials Overview

Here you'll see how to three-star all weekly trials in just two matches without extensive preparation or specific blueprints. We'll cover throwing snowballs at Rocketeers, damaging flying ARC enemies, opening ARC probes, destroying fireballs (all on Cold Snap), and dealing damage to Shredders (on Stella Montes Night Raid).

Step 1: Throw Snowballs at Rocketeers

For a three-star trial, you need to throw 16 snowballs at a Rocketeer. Snowballs spawn in clumps around most buildings on all maps. You can collect one snowball, wait two seconds, and collect another from the exact same spot to stack them efficiently.

  • Collect 20-25 snowballs before engaging if possible.
  • Snowballs will respawn after a short delay, allowing you to pick up multiple from a single spot.

Bringing Down a Rocketeer

Rocketeers are flying enemies, so you need a strategy to ground them:

  • **Less Reliable Method:** Use a Showstopper or Hornet Driver to stun it and hope it lands on its back. This method relies heavily on luck and timing.
  • **Consistent Method:** Shoot two thrusters on the same side of the Rocketeer. This will disable its flight and bring it to the ground.
  • Focus only on the thrusters. Damaging other parts might destroy it before both thrusters are out, making it fly again.

Once grounded, pelt the Rocketeer with snowballs until the trial requirement is met. Each snowball deals 1 damage.

Step 2: Damage Flying ARC Enemies

This trial requires damaging flying ARC enemies like Snitches, Wasps, and Hornets.

  • Find high ground, such as the Grandioso apartment buildings, for better visibility and engagement.
  • Shoot Snitches; they will often spawn waves of Wasps and Hornets, which are flying ARC enemies.
  • You'll come across another Rocketeer later in the match. Aim to damage its thrusters without killing it if other players are around, so they can also complete their trials.

Step 3: Open ARC Probes

To complete this trial, you must open and loot three ARC probes.

  • Find smoke plumes rising into the air across the map; these indicate crashed ARC probes.
  • When you get close, probes will appear on your minimap. Regularly pull up your map to spot them as you traverse the area.
  • You can loot probes that other players have already breached and opened.

Step 4: Destroy Fireballs

You must destroy six fireballs for this trial.

  • A great location for fireballs on Buried City (Cold Snap) is the underground Metro area. In Cold Snap events, the Metro is open, allowing full access.
  • After eliminating fireballs on one side of the Metro, call the train to cross over and find more on the other side.
  • Fireballs also spawn in other buildings like the Hospital, Space Travel, Research & Administration, and Galleria.

Step 5: Deal Damage to Shredders

This trial is best done on Stella Montes Night Raid, where you only need to eliminate three Shredders (instead of six on a normal day raid).

  • **Weapons and Explosives:**
  • Two Snapblast grenades or five Impact grenades thrown at the Shredder's bottom can destroy it.
  • Synthesized Fuel also acts as an effective makeshift explosive and is commonly found in the lobby.
  • The Anvil or Il Toro shotgun are effective weapons. Aim for the three thrusters on the Shredder to quickly destroy it.
  • **Tactics:** Use cover to peek in and out, shooting the Shredder. Retreat behind cover when it's about to fire.
  • **Looting:** Always loot Shredder Gyros, as they are a new requirement for expeditions.
  • **Spawn Locations:** Shredders is inside the Lobby, Sandbox area, Loading Bay Metro, Cultural Archives, Seed Vault Metro/Escape Area, and between Assembly Workshops and Medical Research.

title: Trials High Scoring Guide for Week of Nov 10th
content:
Overview

Here you'll see how to get 3 stars on all weekly trials to earn free rewards and blueprints. We'll cover the best strategies for each trial, featuring best routes, enemy weaknesses, and tips for dealing with other players. Credit to The Gaming Merchant for the tips!

Step 1: Damage Bastions

For the Damage Bastions trial, you need to destroy Bastions found at certain locations. Your goal is to reach one of these locations as quickly as possible so that no other players get there before you. The easiest one to use is the Hydroponic Dome Complex.

  • **Find Bastion Spawns:** Identify the Hydroponic Dome Complex or Power Generation Complex on the map as potential Bastion spawn points.
  • **Rush to Location:** Head directly to one of the Bastion spawn points. The Hydroponic Dome Complex is often the easiest due to a cheese strategy.
  • **Use Door Peeking:** Position yourself at one of the Hydroponic Dome doors. Bait the Bastion towards the door. It's too large to get its head around the corner, allowing you to peek and shoot its kneecaps safely.
  • **Target Kneecaps:** Focus fire on the yellow kneecaps. Destroying them will temporarily disable the Bastion.
  • **Damage During Disable:** When the Bastion is disabled, freely attack it and use any Snapblast grenades or Triggernades for maximum damage.
  • **Inventory Check:** Keep an eye on your ammo and other items in your inventory.
  • **Destroy Bastion:** Continue this process until the Bastion is destroyed.
  • **Player Awareness:** Be cautious of other players attempting to PvP you. Consider bringing barricades to protect your back while engaging the Bastion.
  • **Repeat at Pipeline Tower:** After destroying the first Bastion, quickly move to the Pipeline Tower for the second Bastion.
  • **Optimal Strategy at Pipeline Tower:** Use a similar peeking strategy at the Pipeline Tower entrance, as shown. While not as perfect as Hydroponic, the door still provides significant cover.
  • **Respawn Farming:** Bastions will respawn in the same locations periodically. If you destroy the Hydroponic Dome Bastion fast enough, it will respawn with the next wave, allowing you to repeat the process for more points.
  • **Efficient Looting:** Only spend a short time looting after destroying a Bastion. Time is crucial, and other players may be nearby.
  • **Maximize Spawns:** As a solo player, aiming for two Bastion destructions will get you three stars. If you want to push further, speed-run the first two and then wait for the next spawn wave to fight one or two more.
  • **Time Management:** Always monitor the final extract time. A good rule of thumb is to allow one minute for every 100 meters you must walk to the extraction point.

By following these steps, you can achieve a high score in the Damage Bastions trial.

Step 2: Damage Wasps

The Damage Wasps trial is an excellent opportunity to accumulate a high score, especially during the Spaceport Hidden Bunker event, which offers 2x points.

  • **Choose Spaceport Hidden Bunker:** This event is ideal for Wasp farming due to its bonus points and fewer ground-based ARCs.
  • **Prepare Snitch Scanners:** Before entering the raid, stock up on Snitch Scanners. Bringing 5 will allow you to kill 10 Wasps for a 3-star rating.
  • **Engage Wasps Safely:** Upon arrival, use Snitch Scanners one by one to aggro Wasps. Fight them individually to avoid being overwhelmed.
  • **Use Cover:** Find a safe position, such as inside a building, to peek out and shoot Wasps.
  • **Monitor Scanners:** Keep track of your Snitch Scanners in your inventory.
  • **Launch Tower Strategy:** After using your initial Snitch Scanners, walk to the Launch Tower. Climb the ladder for an advantageous position.
  • **Elevated Position:** The Launch Tower provides a great vantage point, making it difficult for other players to push you while you farm Wasps.
  • **Hidden Bunker Opening:** After the Hidden Bunker is open, most players will rush there, leaving you with free rein to farm Wasps.
  • **Aggro More Wasps:** If you run out of Snitch Scanners, you can shoot nearby passive snitches to aggro Wasps and Hornets towards you.
  • **Wasp Aiming Tip:** Wasps are coded to dodge your aim when you're aiming down sights. Instead, wait for the Wasp to stop moving (usually just before it fires), then aim slightly above its head for a one-shot kill with the Hullcracker.
  • **Hornet Strategy:** The same aiming tip applies to Hornets.
  • **Destroy Entire Wasp:** For maximum points, make sure you destroy the Wasp entirely, not just its wings. Three Anvil shots to the body will kill it.

Step 3: Destroy Fireballs

The best map for destroying Fireballs is Dam Battlegrounds at night, specificly the Testing Annex area.

  • **Optimal Location:** Go to the Testing Annex on Dam Battlegrounds (Night Raid).
  • **Fireball Spawns:** This area is rich with Fireball spawns, specificly in the underground sections and buildings.
  • **Optimal Route:** Start at Water Treatment Control, go through the underground to Primary Facility, then Control Tower, and finally Research & Administration. There are many Fireballs in these areas.
  • **Shooting Fireballs:** Focus on shooting the Fireballs as they appear. They often come in groups.
  • **Efficient Pathing:** Continue moving through the designated route, destroying Fireballs as they spawn. After you've cleared the Fireballs in one area, move to the next.
  • **Keep Moving:** If no more Fireballs are spawning in your current location, continue to Power Generation Complex or other marked areas, always keeping an eye on the final extract.

Step 4: Download Data during Hidden Bunker

This trial requires you to download data from PCs within the Hidden Bunker, usually on the Spaceport map.

  • **Access Hidden Bunker:** Wait for the Hidden Bunker event to be available. Activate the satellites to open the bunker entrance.
  • **Find PCs:** After entering, find the PCs in the Hidden Bunker. There are generally eight PCs available for data download.
  • **Initiate Download:** interact with a PC to start the data download. You must stay close to the PC for the download to continue.
  • **Wait for Completion:** Stay near the PC until the download is complete. This process takes some time.
  • **Repeat for All PCs:** Download data from all eight PCs to maximize your score (up to 6,400 points).
  • **Cooldown Period:** If another player has recently downloaded from a PC, it will be on a short cooldown (1-2 minutes) before you can access it.
  • **Solo vs. Squad:** Doing this solo can be boring but is an easy way to get points. In solos, other players are often friendly and will share PCs.

Step 5: Deliver Carriables

For the Deliver Carriables mission, the most efficient way to collect and deliver carriables is by utilizing Field Depots.

  • **Field Depot Locations:** Field Depots are available on Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, and Spaceport.
  • **Collect Carriables:** Find and collect carriables (e.g., batteries, data drives). You can often find multiple carriables around Field Depots.
  • **Deliver to Depot:** Drop your collected carriables into the Field Depots. You can deposit more than one carriable in each depot.
  • **Maximize Deliveries:** Aim to deliver four batteries in a Night Raid to achieve the full three stars for this trial.
summary: This tutorial offers expert strategies and ideal routes to achieve 3-star ratings on all weekly trials in the game, centered on maximizing points for Bastions, Wasps, Fireballs, and data downloads.

title: Trials Week 5
content:
Overview: Maximize Your Trial Points

For all trial challenges, aim to finish them during major map conditions like Night Raids, Electromagnetic Storms, or the Hidden Bunker event, which offer a 2x bonus on your UI. Always load into a fresh map to maximize your time, keeping an eye on the timer at the highest point of your screen. If you're in at the 30-40 minute mark, you'll maximize points. Staying in the round until the last minutes and extracting after most players have left can often be safer when playing solo. Remember, you must successfully extract to retain any points earned.

Trial 1: Damage Rocketeers

This challenge pushes both solo players and teams to deal as much damage as possible to Rocketeers in a single raid. Full points are awarded if you or your team are the sole ones damaging a Rocketeer until it's brought down. Consider using a combination of Wolfpacks, Hullcrackers, Jupiters, and Heavy Ammo based weapons for maximum efficiency.

  • A full kill of a Rocketeer is worth about 2600 points. You'll need two kills to hit the three-star threshold.
  • Farming Location 1: Spaceport Launch Tower
  • Anchor yourself midway up on the Spaceport Launch Tower during any major map condition, ideally the Hidden Bunker for extra farming time. From here, set up mines on entry points and use great sightlines to pull every Rocketeer on the map towards you. Be aware, this is a high-traffic area, so players may attempt to engage in PvP.
  • Farming Location 2: Blue Gate Pilgrim's Peak Tower
  • Another excellent location is the tower at Pilgrim's Peak on Blue Gate. Bring a sniper and Wolfpacks to easily pull every Rocketeer on the map. This location also features a double Rocketeer spawn, meaning two quick kills with less resistance.
  • Targeting Rocketeers: Aim for the armor paneling over its central eye with heavy or energy ammo weapons. Breaking this panel exposes its crit spot, allowing for quick takedowns with regular gunfire.

Step 2: Download Data During Hidden Bunker

This trial requires downloading data from terminals inside the Hidden Bunker. We strongly recommend doing this solo due to the nature of the lobbies, but it takes a significant amount of time to complete.

  • There are only 8 terminals inside the Hidden Bunker, each awarding 800 points per download. You need five terminals to arrive at the three-star ranking.
  • Activating the Bunker: When you load into the Hidden Bunker map, four antennas need to be activated before the bunker opens. These antennas are randomly placed at the start of the map.
  • Entering the Bunker: Once all antennas are active, go to the bunker entrance.
  • Downloading Data: Inside, find the eight computer terminals. Activate a terminal to begin downloading data. A yellow light will flash, and a green progress bar will appear. After the bar completes, the light turns green, and data can be collected.
  • Strategic Data Collection: Pay attention to which consoles are near completion and grab the data if you can. Move on to the next activated console rather than activating a new one yourself if other players are present, as you'll be stuck there during the download. Be cautious, as players can get impatient and attempt to use grenades.
  • If you download all eight terminals and successfully extract, you'll secure 6400 points.

Step 3: Search First Wave Husks

Searching First Wave Husks is a straightforward challenge with high point farming potential. Each husk awards around 800 points.

  • Find dead ARC bodies (Rocketter husks, Baron husks, Hornet husks) that you can breach and loot throughout the environment. You can either be the one to breach them or just interact with ones already breached by other players.
  • Optimal Location: Spaceport
  • Spaceport is probably the best option due to the high number of husks that spawn on the outskirts of the map, away from typical danger zones. These areas rarely see PvP action.
  • This challenge is free loadout friendly, but bringing adrenaline shots is recommended to manage running across the map more efficiently.

Step 4: Damage Snitches

Damaging Snitches offers huge point farming potential because they respawn quickly once killed.

  • Each Snitch awards 600 points, so you only need seven to achieve your three-star ranking for the week.
  • Elevated Strategy: Get yourself or your team to an elevated, centralized location on the map. Use a sniper or Jupiter to pull every Snitch to you.
  • Map Conditions: Hidden Bunker offers extra time, making it a prime location. Night Raid and any other 2x condition on any map will also work. The key is elevation, the ability to defend that elevation from other teams, and suitable gear to quickly pull and take down ARC enemies.

Step 5: Damage Ground-Based ARC Enemies

While this challenge has high point farming potential, it's often the hardest to achieve a high score due to contested enemies. You'll only receive 80% of the total XP gained on kills as points, meaning smaller enemies like Picks, Pops, and Fireballs yield very few points.

  • Focus on Larger Enemies: Target larger enemies such as Bastions, Bombardiers, and Leapers, as these are ideal for farming points.
  • Optimal Location: Hidden Bunker
  • Hidden Bunker remains the best place to wrap up this challenge. Leapers, Bastions, and Bombardiers will spawn above the Hidden Bunker in a centralized location, and you'll have an extra 10 minutes to farm. Be aware, this will be a PvP hot zone.
  • Alternative Location: Dam Battlegrounds (Electromagnetic Storm)
  • Dam Battlegrounds during an Electromagnetic Storm is another ideal map. It features two Bastion spawns, a Bombardier spawn, and three to five Leaper spawns. This gives solo players more options to avoid PvP, and groups can split up to maximize farming efforts.
summary: This tutorial offers an in-depth breakdown of all the Week 5 competitive trial challenges, offering strategies, recommended gear, and ideal locations to efficiently earn maximum points and climb the leaderboards.

title: Trials Week 6 High Scoring Guide
content:
Overview: Weekly Trials & General Tips

This week's trials offer great potential for high scores, with the possibility of reaching 150,000 to 200,000 points. The guide will detail strategies for solo completion to achieve three stars, identifying the best point-farming opportunities, and suggesting free loadout-friendly options.

  • Major Map Conditions for Full Points: Only certain conditions yield full points: Hidden Bunker, Night Raids, and Electromagnetic Storms. Minor conditions like Harvesters or Matriarchs only grant half points.
  • Optimal Playstyle: For achieving three stars, playing solo is often easier due to fewer player interactions. Though, for maximum leaderboard points, playing in a group of three is recommended. [SCREENSHOT:01:15]
  • Hidden Bunker Map: While less reliant this week, the Hidden Bunker condition still offers the best environment for several trials.

Step 1: Damage Hornets

  • Points: 365 points per thruster kill, 760 points per main body kill. High farm potential, but not ideal for free loadouts.
  • Recommended Farm Location: Spaceport, in specific the Trench Towers (South or North).
  • Strategy:
  • Drop into a Hidden Bunker map condition.
  • Use Adrenaline Shots to quickly reach one of the Trench Towers.
  • Zipline onto the tower.
  • Deploy Barricades and Traps around your position.
  • Make sure weapons are well-repaired and bring plenty of ammo.
  • This high ground position offers excellent safety from other players and consistent Hornet spawns.
  • Respawn Optimization: Kill all wasps and hornets in a patrol to encourage faster respawns of new patrols. If only hornets are killed, wasps remaining might delay new spawns.
  • Maximize Points: Aim for the main body of the Hornet (760 points) instead of just the thrusters (365 points) for higher scores.
  • By following this method, players can realistically achieve upwards of 48,000 points in this trial.

Step 2: Deliver Carriables



  • Points: 1000 points per carriable delivered. Bad farm potential, but great for free loadouts.
  • Recommended Maps: Spaceport or Dam Battlegrounds for the highest potential Field Crate spawns.
  • Strategy:
  • Use an online interactive map to track potential Field Crate spawns.
  • Expect around 10 Field Crates per game at best.
  • Be aware of other players also doing this challenge, as they can clear spawns. [SCREENSHOT:05:35]
  • For a solo three-star completion, it's manageable, but for leaderboard farming, it requires many attempts and good RNG due to competition.
  • Focus on getting the three stars and don't over-invest if other players are active.

Step 3: Damage Rocketeers, Leapers or Bastions


  • Points: Approximately 2,200 points per kill (tested on leapers & rocketeers). Great farm potential, but bad for free loadouts.
  • Recommended Location: Spaceport, in certain the bottom of the Launch Towers.
  • Strategy:
  • This is an aggressive position, so be prepared for PvP run intos.
  • From the Launch Tower, you can spot 2-3 Leaper spawns, 3 Rocketeer spawns, and even a Bastion spawn.
  • Hidden Bunker Alternative: The Hidden Bunker map also works for extra time, but beware of Bombardiers in the same areas as Bastions, which can be problematic.

Step 4: Destroy Pops


  • Points: 880 points per kill. Great farm potential, great for free loadouts (just needs loot ammo).
  • Recommended Location: Stella Montis, certainly during a Night Raid map condition.
  • Strategy:
  • Queue for Stella Montis - Night Raid when it's nearing its final minutes or seconds. This can lead to a game that won't respawn new players, creating a quieter lobby for solo farming.
  • Remain quiet in the initial minutes to allow other players to fight or extract, shrinking the lobby.
  • After the lobby is smaller, rotate between the two sandbox areas, control areas, and the Metro Station extraction point, as Pops respawn quickly in these areas.
  • Alternative: If Stella Montis isn't ideal, Buried City is your second-best option. Focus on Research, Space Travel, Parking Garage, Hospital, and extraction points.

Step 5: Open ARC Probes


  • Points: 1,334 points per search. Extremely free loadout friendly, great farm potential.
  • Recommended Map: Dam Battlegrounds on an Electromagnetic Storm. [SCREENSHOT:09:59]
  • Strategy:
  • Bring a lot of Adrenaline Shots to quickly cover the map.
  • In Electromagnetic Storms, probes often spawn in packs of two or three. [SCREENSHOT:10:07]
  • You don't need an interactive map; just pay attention to the dark smoke coming from breached ARCs and constantly check your map.
  • ARC probes will show up on your map when you zoom in, even if they're far away.
  • Important: It's about 'searching' the probe, not 'breaching' it. If another player has already breached a probe, you can still search it for points.
summary: Here we explain how to efficiently complete the current weekly trials and certain farming methods for each challenge to maximize your earned points.

title: Trials Week 7
content:
Overview: Weekly Trials Week 7

This week marks the final week for Trials in Season 1, extending until Tuesday, offering players an extra day to complete objectives. The primary focus for many will be maintaining their current rank, though pushing for higher ranks is still possible. For maximum points, prioritize trials within major map conditions like Night Raids or Electromagnetic Storms, which grant double points. Queen/Matriarch trials, though, should be tackled in their specific minor map conditions (Harvester or Matriarch events).

Destroy Ticks, Fireballs, and Pops

  • Each kill grants 470 points.
  • The best map for this challenge is Stella Montis, in specific during a Night Raid event.
  • Stella Montis is densely populated with Ticks, Pops, and Fireballs.
  • Strategic Queuing: Queue for a Night Raid on Stella Montis when it's nearing its final seconds or minutes. This can lead to an empty lobby with no mid-raid player respawns, allowing you to clear ARCs solo without PvP interference.
  • Recommended Locations:
  • The Seed Vault has about 6-8 Ticks.
  • Archives is rich with Pops, Fireballs, and mini Ticks, certainly on the ceiling.
  • The Control Rooms are also excellent spots for Pops and Fireballs.
  • PvP Avoidance: Avoid high PvP areas like the Lobby, Medical Research, and Loading Bay. If you hear gunshots, change direction. After the lobby starts to clear up, you can extend your search.

Search resource drops

  • Each Supply Pod searched grants 1600 points.
  • This trial is highly RNG-dependent; there isn't one definitive best map. Spaceport has historically been consistent, though the video demonstrates a run on Dam Battlegrounds.
  • Identifying Supply Stations: Find a glowing white bulb shining on top of the station to indicate it hasn't been used yet.
  • Gaining Points: You only need to 'tap' (loot) the supply pod to gain points; you don't need to call it in yourself.
  • Our interactive map can show potential spawn locations for them

Damage Wasps

  • Each Wasp main body kill grants ~440 points.
  • The ideal location is Hidden Bunker when it's activated, as it spawns Wasps.
  • Alternatively, Spaceport during a Night Raid or Electromagnetic Storm event is a strong choice, centered on the Launch Tower or Control Tower areas.
  • Strategy with Snitch Scanners: Hoard multiple Snitch Scanners, then position yourself on a high vantage point like the top of a tower on Spaceport. Deploy traps at entrances and use scanners to detect and eliminate Wasps as they appear. This is highly consistent for points.
  • Strategy without Scanners: Take high ground (e.g., a tower), use traps to protect yourself, and attract Snitches. Snitches will call in two extra Wasps per reinforcement, helping you meet the ~10 Wasps needed for three stars.

Damage Bastions

  • Each Bastion kill grants ~4510 points.
  • Hidden Bunker, if active, is ideal as it spawns two Bastions directly on top, allowing for continuous farming.
  • Spaceport is also an excellent choice, with a solid six potential spawn locations, usually guaranteeing two Bastions per game. You can rotate between kills and allowing them to respawn.
  • Easy 3-Star Method: Bring 2-3 Wolfpacks; throwing them at a Bastion will instantly kill it, allowing for a quick extraction.
  • Farming Strategy (Spaceport): For sustained point farming, either sit on top of Trench Tower and kill the Bastion below it or bunker up on Container Storage. Be mindful of PvP, as heavy weapons like the Hullcracker attract attention.
  • If aiming for 3 stars without min-maxing, two Bastion kills are enough for over 8,000 points.

Damage Queens or Matriarchs

  • Damage dealt translates to points at a 0.7:1 ratio. You need 5715 damage (not XP) to head over to the 3-star threshold.
  • This is the most challenging and expensive trial for solo players.
  • Method 1 (High Cost, Low Effort): Use roughly eight Wolfpacks. Each Wolfpack deals around 750 damage, totaling ~6000 damage, easily exceeding the 3-star requirement. This is costly but effective.
  • Method 2 (Risky): Get on top of the Queen/Matriarch and place Deadline mines. This can deal significant damage but is highly dangerous.
  • Method 3 (Recommended): Use a Jupiter instead of a Hullcracker. The Jupiter deals greatly more damage per shot and its ammo is cheaper to craft/buy. This method allows for faster damage accumulation.
  • Safe Positioning: When engaging the Queen/Matriarch, find high ground or cover.
  • Group Play: This trial is best completed in a trio. If other teams join the fight, they will steal damage points from you, making it harder to reach the 3-star threshold. Coordinate with your team to deal the damage and secure the kill entirely for yourselves.

title: Turnabout
content:
Overview

The 'Turnabout' quest asks you to get the Spaceport Trench Tower Key, head over to the North Trench Tower, find and upload the blackmail files to Celeste, and then successfully extract from the area.

Step 1: Prepare Your Loadout

  • Make sure you have equipped an augment that includes at least one safe pocket in your loadout. [SCREENSHOT:00:15]
  • Place the 'Spaceport Trench Tower Key' (provided by the quest) into your safe pocket for safekeeping.
  • Note: If you happen to lose the key, there is replacements by looting containers like drawers, cupboards, and lockers across any map.

Step 2: Head Toward North Trench Tower

  • Once spawned into Spaceport, check your map and spot the 'North Trench Tower' located in the far northeast section of the map.
  • While the quest key can open either the North or South Trench Tower, your objective in certain requires entry into the North Trench Tower.

Step 3: Enter the Tower

  • Go to the North Trench Tower from 'The Trench' area.
  • Find the external stairs leading up to an underground floor entrance. Climb these stairs.
  • Go through the underground section, going up internal stairs to reach the surface level of the tower.
  • On the surface, find one of the two main doors. Interact to unlock and open it.

Step 4: Upload Blackmail Files

  • After going into the tower, navigate through the first floor. There aren't any key objectives here, but you can search breach boxes for loot.
  • Find and climb the stairs leading up to the second floor.
  • On the second floor, find a computer station positioned in the center, on the northeastern side of the room.
  • Use the computer to upload the blackmail files.

Step 5: Extract and Claim Rewards

  • After uploading the files, all that remains is to successfully extract from the mission area.
  • Head back to Celeste at your base to hand in the quest and claim your rewards.

title: Weekly Trials Nov 17th
content:
Overview

In this guide, we explain tips for excelling in the weekly trials from November 17th to 23rd, centered on specific objectives like harvesting plants, opening ARC probes, damaging flying ARC enemies, and damaging leapers. Pay attention to major map conditions for 2x points to maximize your score.

Used this video by Ebontis to make this guide

Step 1: Harvest Plants

For the 'Harvest Plants' trial, you must harvest specific plant types like mushrooms, Great Mullein, or moss that have a fill-up bar, not just regular pickups.

  • Mushrooms are generally unreliable to find.
  • Some moss is in the Hydroponic Dome Complex in Dam Battlegrounds.
  • **Best location:** Buried City, in certain the Galleria on a Night Raid condition.
  • You can find many Great Mullein plants in planters and lobbies, offering about 500 points each (about 26-30 per run).

Step 2: Open ARC Probes

For the 'Open ARC Probes' trial, you'll want to target probes with a ring around them that require interaction to open. ARC Couriers usually do not count.

  • Choose larger maps with 2x point conditions, such as Hidden Bunker, to get more time (40 minutes instead of 30).
  • Each probe is worth around 1334 points, so opening three on a Night Raid will usually secure your 4000 points.
  • You can get lucky with multiple probes spawning close together, like the example of three probes near the Breach on Dam Battlegrounds during an Electromagnetic Storm.
  • To open a probe, you must breach it open and then examine the container.

Step 3: Damage Flying ARC Enemies

This broad trial includes various flying enemies like Wasps, Spotters, Snitches, Hornets, and Rocketeers.

  • For efficiency, consider using a **Hullcracker** (launcher weapon) as it has very strong ARC armor penetration.
  • The Hullcracker costs 30,000 currency and can be purchased once every 24 hours. Stock up on Launcher Ammo.
  • When targeting Rocketeers, focus fire on one side to disable two engines quickly, bringing them down.
  • Use **Snitch Scanners** to call in more enemies, featuring flying ones, to increase your damage output and points.
  • Hullcracker can often one-shot Wasps and Hornets.

Step 4: Damage Leapers

Leapers are exposed to fire damage.

  • Use **Blaze Grenades** to set the ground on fire when Leapers jump at you or are stationary.
  • **Fireball Burners** (from Fireballs) can also be effective.
  • The **Snap Blast Grenade** is recommended because it sticks to enemies, making it easier to deal consistent damage.
  • The **Heavy Fuse Grenade** is an alternative but less reliable due to Leapers' movement.
  • The **Deadline mine** is really good if you can attach it to a Leaper, dealing a significant amount of damage.
  • Try running missions with an Electromagnetic Storm condition, as Leapers seem to be more common.
  • Hidden Bunker missions offer longer time (40 minutes) to find and defeat Leapers.

Step 5: Damage Queens or Matriarchs

This trial has you damage either Queens or Matriarchs, which usually appear as specific map conditions.

  • Right now, no Queen or Matriarch missions are active, but keep an eye out for them in areas like Spaceport or Hidden Bunker.
